0A4B3979A41D06EDBFC4DE0ADD62E5EE.source: The knight takes the old coat from her arms and lays it around her shoulders. Then it kneels.
0A4B3979A41D06EDBFC4DE0ADD62E5EE.target: 骑士从她怀里接过那件旧大衣，披在她肩上。然后，它跪了下来。

0A0024455200703DBC3AC72D1668DB85.source: That knight of yours is the best scarecrow Amberfield's ever had. Not one crow's touched the pie.
0A0024455200703DBC3AC72D1668DB85.target: 你们那位骑士呀，是琥珀原有过的最好的稻草人。一只乌鸦都没碰过那馅饼哪。

00D555ACFBBAD5C5A2E11F01CD4CC173.source: If it goes badly up there, I want it known I was the handsome one. Tell it bigger than it was. I would.
00D555ACFBBAD5C5A2E11F01CD4CC173.target: 万一上头情况不妙，记得告诉大家，我是长得最俊的那个。往大了说。换我就会。

0DB5668DDCE3BDA407E640F76FE0B7DD.source: There's the wind! And — oh, lovely. There's what was in the fog.
0DB5668DDCE3BDA407E640F76FE0B7DD.target: 起风啦！还有——哎哟，真是好极了。雾里藏着的东西也出来了。

0E9FB47A9A14C64F1AA0B859EDDFCFAB.source: The ice went! I was standing on it! Well — near it. Well — I saw it.
0E9FB47A9A14C64F1AA0B859EDDFCFAB.target: 冰化了！我当时就站在上面！呃——在旁边。呃——我看见了。

0EF5CCC2237E3F96A161E632A7045B11.source: The east bell! Did you bring me a leaf? A red one?
0EF5CCC2237E3F96A161E632A7045B11.target: 东边的钟！你给我带叶子了吗？红的那种？

0F2A7434774AD2491564D2D7EF35291A.source: → Amberfield, across the fields. The Bell of Harvest.
0F2A7434774AD2491564D2D7EF35291A.target: → 琥珀原，穿过田野便到。丰收之钟。

0F6597ED174915F23FD974DAF331519A.source: Gran says flowers are like snow, only they come up instead of down.
0F6597ED174915F23FD974DAF331519A.target: 阿婆说，花就像雪一样，只不过不是往下落，是往上长。

1BAFE622A8C45A61355C9E8C88B1B442.source: The great mould. He broke it open the night he left, and never said what he'd poured.
1BAFE622A8C45A61355C9E8C88B1B442.target: 大钟模。他走的那晚把它砸开了，浇的是什么，他始终没说。

1BCD40537F29C567C0E862DCA86272B4.source: The sails are turning. That's all this one has to give.
1BCD40537F29C567C0E862DCA86272B4.target: 风车转起来了。这一座能给的就这些。

1CC4934F310A6F0A9033EA4EC8DCE731.source: I'm staying. That's the whole story.
1CC4934F310A6F0A9033EA4EC8DCE731.target: 我不走了。整个故事就这么多。

1E0B6408C33C8801184060A002876F4A.source: Once. The second was an accident.

1E7A6587A8F2BCB93EDD700D47B23E71.source: Cut logs, stacked to the rafters. Seven winters of firewood, and still the cold comes in.
1E7A6587A8F2BCB93EDD700D47B23E71.target: 劈好的木柴一直堆到房梁。备了七个冬天的柴火，寒气还是照样往里钻。

1EF6CA4615A334008147BA3E4877EA55.source: The lodge is shut. Frost has grown over the latch like a second lock.
1EF6CA4615A334008147BA3E4877EA55.target: 小屋关着门。门闩上长满了霜，像又加了一道锁。

1F12C146BE96A587C5A3154F79312765.source: Snow on its pauldrons, frost in every joint. It has stood at the forge door every night for seven winters, and never once crossed the threshold.
1F12C146BE96A587C5A3154F79312765.target: 肩甲上积着雪，每个关节都结了霜。七个冬天，它每晚都站在铸钟坊门口，却从没跨过门槛一步。

02A7D8A78786BED13876D9C6B08D183C.source: A Waking Cake, fresh this morning. In case today's the day.
02A7D8A78786BED13876D9C6B08D183C.target: 苏醒蛋糕，今早刚出炉的。万一就是今天呢。

2B950D4017D100E78A2A11853AB24B57.source: A sign: GONE TO EVERMERE. BACK WHEN THE TIDE IS.
2B950D4017D100E78A2A11853AB24B57.target: 一块牌子：去永湖镇了。潮水回来，人就回来。

2B8477359E1102F01F9C90859FB26030.source: Your knight's gone from the door, love. Gave me a turn this morning.
2B8477359E1102F01F9C90859FB26030.target: 你那位骑士不在门口了，孩子。今早可把我吓了一跳。

2BCE368F30A851C752ADB1730B56FE7A.source: You rang it! Did you see one? A flower?
2BCE368F30A851C752ADB1730B56FE7A.target: 你把钟敲响啦！你看见了吗？花？

2BF33C690D6A60A3CDFB3169E2FF088B.source: Amberfield's harvest stands frozen in the fields. Its abbey holds the Bell of Harvest.
2BF33C690D6A60A3CDFB3169E2FF088B.target: 琥珀原的庄稼还立在田里，冻得硬邦邦的。那里的修道院挂着丰收之钟。

2C0D8E087698C1BB49B364B941A4C0EE.source: I've seen the sea, you know. Twice. Once it was the wrong colour.
2C0D8E087698C1BB49B364B941A4C0EE.target: 我跟你说，我见过大海。两回呢。有一回颜色还不对。

2C1629F4DC2EE2B87C89C7A22D3BD17B.source: Some nights the wall hums. Same note every time. Gets in your teeth.
2C1629F4DC2EE2B87C89C7A22D3BD17B.target: 有些夜里，那道墙会嗡嗡作响。每回都是同一个音。震得人牙根发酸。

02D0F74A755B45E4E022B09E00525D04.source: Ow! I set it for a bear. A small bear.
02D0F74A755B45E4E022B09E00525D04.target: 哎哟！那是给熊下的套。一头小熊。

2DD390B8865572D9797FA2DD4D27B678.source: Black bell, white fog, and then you, grey as a gull. What day is it?
2DD390B8865572D9797FA2DD4D27B678.target: 黑钟，白雾，再一睁眼就是你，灰得跟海鸥似的。今天星期几了？

2E913D91B0466EF9206E80C0AB1BFB0D.source: Bunks for forty, made up neat. The blankets have frozen to the frames.
2E913D91B0466EF9206E80C0AB1BFB0D.target: 四十张床铺，铺得整整齐齐。毯子都冻在了床架上。

2EC69AEB831FEFFC7B012D5F72893726.source: She climbed that ladder steadier than I held it. Seven, and she's never seen a lantern lit for anything good.
2EC69AEB831FEFFC7B012D5F72893726.target: 她爬那梯子，比我扶得还稳当。才七岁，还从没见过哪盏灯是为好事点的。

2ECC9E6AC5FF1E544B7DBC0F59FD19E6.source: The coat was Grandda's. The drawing was mine. The Bell of Harvest waits at the abbey.
2ECC9E6AC5FF1E544B7DBC0F59FD19E6.target: 那件大衣是外公的。那幅画是我画的。丰收之钟在修道院等着。

02F77C53E3F9DD4280E22BC0212B89AC.source: …It's so small. Gran said they'd be small. I didn't believe her.
02F77C53E3F9DD4280E22BC0212B89AC.target: ……好小呀。阿婆说过花是小小的。我还不信呢。

3AFD02ABD1C1E2E51641CB537BD7E456.source: I've an invoice drawn up for whoever stopped the year. Lamp oil, one harbour, seven years of a brother. Itemised.
3AFD02ABD1C1E2E51641CB537BD7E456.target: 让这一年停住的那位，我给他开好了一张账单。灯油、一座港口、一个弟弟的七年。逐项列明。

3B0068974203C509A0DEA6766732C751.source: The Bell of Harvest hangs in the abbey belfry at Amberfield. The road leaves from the east shore, across the frozen lake.
3B0068974203C509A0DEA6766732C751.target: 丰收之钟挂在琥珀原修道院的钟楼里。路从东岸出发，要穿过结冰的湖面。

3C27DC030C66BA101CA86CA0DFC277A2.source: So this is where the hammer lives. Smaller than I pictured. Warmer, too. Nobody's been properly warm since the ice.
3C27DC030C66BA101CA86CA0DFC277A2.target: 原来锤子就住在这儿呀。比我想的小，也暖和些。自从结冰以来，谁都没真正暖和过。

3CE1F5A49B795A9DE08446055B9FB443.source: The way up to the Close. Ringers first — remember.
3CE1F5A49B795A9DE08446055B9FB443.target: 上围场的路。先对付鸣钟者——记住。

3DFEE3ACF2425866EA197404D86E9336.source: The west bell! I put an extra egg in this morning's, for luck. Number 2,563.
3DFEE3ACF2425866EA197404D86E9336.target: 西边的钟响啦！今早那个我多打了一个鸡蛋，讨个好兆头。第2563个。

04AE3745C99EA961528F19948D8DF7FB.source: He's up there. Grandda. He's been up there the whole time.
04AE3745C99EA961528F19948D8DF7FB.target: 他在上面。外公。他一直都在上面。

4B9A2793E4D66F76C3AFA1482EAC6341.source: Truer again. Two notes of the four.
4B9A2793E4D66F76C3AFA1482EAC6341.target: 又准了些。四个音里准了两个。

4B94FDE9ADF44E03CA9A664D3194D811.source: Three beats, then the cold comes down. Anyone not by a fire went flat at the gate — I counted.
4B94FDE9ADF44E03CA9A664D3194D811.target: 钟响三下，寒气就压下来了。在城门那儿，没站在火边的全趴下了——我数过。

4BF9BB5909038F123D8508B626DAFB7D.source: Wake, little blossom, the frost's letting go… Turn, little tide, bring the boats back to shore…
4BF9BB5909038F123D8508B626DAFB7D.target: 醒来吧，小花苞，冰花正松手……转回吧，小潮水，送船儿归岸……

4C6D5EC1CFF8A67F52BEF4BAAB999C95.source: See the falls? Froze the night the bells stopped. Mid-pour. I was standing about where you are.
4C6D5EC1CFF8A67F52BEF4BAAB999C95.target: 看见那瀑布没？钟声停的那晚冻住的。泻到一半，就那么停了。我当时差不多就站在你这个位置。

4C11B998B3F8BB74246BF69804EA7ED2.source: I'll see what I can do, sparrow.

4C419B9939AD9AE35CD3E895A0414EC4.source: A seashell, Linnet. From the sea. South.
4C419B9939AD9AE35CD3E895A0414EC4.target: 贝壳哦，琳内特。海里的。在南边。

04CA36F8E1E38D0207C44A890F23BE07.source: I asked him. I was ten, and Mam was cold, and I asked him not to let it be morning.
04CA36F8E1E38D0207C44A890F23BE07.target: 是我求他的。那年我十岁，妈浑身冰凉，我求他别让天亮。

4CAD349F5ACF46B61C222BF88420EF13.source: It's breathing. Frost, but breathing. It isn't the stag that's wrong — it's the cold in it.
4CAD349F5ACF46B61C222BF88420EF13.target: 还在喘气。满身是霜，可还在喘气。出问题的不是雄鹿——是它身体里的寒气。

4DE0AD811E9D04BE4E212EF383540099.source: Your knight's at the forge door again. Every night. You'd think it'd want a sit-down.
4DE0AD811E9D04BE4E212EF383540099.target: 你那位骑士又站在铸钟坊门口啦。天天晚上都是。它就不想坐下歇会儿吗？

5A88CF2F3BC3629F146ECE34F7AEFAA7.2.source: Wake, little blossom, the frost's letting go
5A88CF2F3BC3629F146ECE34F7AEFAA7.2.target: 醒来吧，小花苞，冰花正松手

5B53A66D7B3DFCB22696BB8C87CFA118.2.source: Turn, little tide, bring the boats back to shore
5B53A66D7B3DFCB22696BB8C87CFA118.2.target: 转回吧，小潮水，送船儿归岸

5BE10955762EE8A1241BC9D7CFF0B253.source: The root bridge. I'd forgotten it was under there. So had the roots, I expect.
5BE10955762EE8A1241BC9D7CFF0B253.target: 树根桥！我都忘了它在底下了。我猜那些树根也忘了。

5C6A35E1BA9EFB59C776D1EE21FCA0D8.source: Nothing. Armour full of frost. Hit it hard enough and the cold lets go.
5C6A35E1BA9EFB59C776D1EE21FCA0D8.target: 没什么。不过是灌满了霜的盔甲。敲得够重，寒气就松手了。

5C9CC45F3F6753C65C3667B99FD6EE2A.source: Empty armour, standing where it chose to stand. Blossom has settled in its open helm.
5C9CC45F3F6753C65C3667B99FD6EE2A.target: 一具空盔甲，站在它自己选定的地方。花瓣落进了它敞开的头盔里。

5CD43AA8DFC6E0BE2B25CA543BBFE101.source: That log's been stuck upstream since the first winter. I'd have charged you a toll to cross it.
5CD43AA8DFC6E0BE2B25CA543BBFE101.target: 那根木头打头一个冬天起就卡在上游。它要是早漂到这儿，我非收你过桥费不可。

5D05FFFEC6C4AE7C68BE9943E61052DF.source: Warmest I've been since the Blossomwood. Which was frozen.
5D05FFFEC6C4AE7C68BE9943E61052DF.target: 自打离开繁花林，我就没这么暖和过。那地方可是冻着的。

5D11B696F6241D99F268EBAD5CFF5A13.source: Linnet. I'm going up to the shrine to ring the Bell of Waking.
5D11B696F6241D99F268EBAD5CFF5A13.target: 琳内特。我要上神祠去，敲响苏醒之钟。

5E7E55F781922778EE7838EADABA5C5F.source: A red leaf next. Don't forget. I've written it on my hand.
5E7E55F781922778EE7838EADABA5C5F.target: 下一样是红叶哦。别忘了。我都写在手上啦。

5E013A7011D4E45A2E6F370B7B0873A0.source: Corin Ashby — poacher, guide, last man in the Blossomwood. And that's a bell-founder's hammer, so you're the Halloway girl.
5E013A7011D4E45A2E6F370B7B0873A0.target: 科林·阿什比——偷猎的、带路的，繁花林里剩下的最后一个人。还有，那是把铸钟匠的锤子，所以你就是哈洛韦家的丫头啦。

5EF55C0F1BADA46EA5CD682CDD055A76.source: It wants them in order. Those three notes — they're the start of Mam's song.
5EF55C0F1BADA46EA5CD682CDD055A76.target: 它要按顺序来。那三个音——是妈妈那首歌的开头。

5F0B3236631FFABAA2EA2E8ECD53BE36.source: The stag? It goes up into the high wood every spring and comes down every autumn. Seven years it stood still. Now it's late, and it knows it.
5F0B3236631FFABAA2EA2E8ECD53BE36.target: 那头雄鹿？它每年春天上高林，秋天再下来。七年来它一动不动。如今它晚了，它自己也知道。

5F7A1DBA5E2DE7E91E6F38E7403BF2E0.source: That drift on the beach went with the ice. And there's a box under it. Finders keepers is a harbour rule, isn't it?
5F7A1DBA5E2DE7E91E6F38E7403BF2E0.target: 沙滩上那堆雪跟着冰一起没了。底下还有个箱子。谁捡到归谁，这是港口的规矩，对吧？

5F654F034973A7B308C4ED3CDBF04D4D.source: It tilts its helm, as if listening for something a long way off.
5F654F034973A7B308C4ED3CDBF04D4D.target: 它微微侧过头盔，像是在倾听远方的什么声音。

6A6241E3C0ABA79A129D59744C6D1121.source: A Waking Cake for the first morning. And tomorrow I shall bake something else entirely. I don't know what. Isn't it marvellous?
6A6241E3C0ABA79A129D59744C6D1121.target: 第一个早晨，就配一个苏醒蛋糕。明天呀，我要烤点完全不一样的东西。烤什么我还不知道呢。是不是妙极了？

6ACA84A842ABA8CB935BDC7CB300475C.source: Seven winters, and nobody's dared touch it.
6ACA84A842ABA8CB935BDC7CB300475C.target: 七个冬天了，谁都没敢碰它。

6B810FD127C9667831360F91317CD6D6.source: A flower. A real one. Not a paper one — Cobb made me a paper one and it doesn't count.
6B810FD127C9667831360F91317CD6D6.target: 一朵花。真的花。不要纸做的——科布给我做过一朵纸花，那个不算。

6C250C869543A5049B80F53D972AACB5.source: I've lit the harbour lamp every night since the ice came. Two thousand five hundred and fifty-seven lamps. Somebody owes me for the oil.
6C250C869543A5049B80F53D972AACB5.target: 自从结冰以来，港口的灯我每晚都点。两千五百五十七盏灯。灯油钱总得有人付。

6CF9D02AF9FAD8B094F9D9EC85959A42.source: Seven winters ago the bells of the valley fell silent and the year stopped turning. Four Season Bells stand at its edges — Waking, Tides, Harvest, Rest — and they have to ring in that order. Grandda's hammer will have to do.
6CF9D02AF9FAD8B094F9D9EC85959A42.target: 七个冬天以前，山谷的钟声沉寂了，这一年也停住了，不再流转。四口季节之钟分立在山谷四边——苏醒、潮汐、丰收、安眠——必须按这个顺序敲响。外公的锤子，只好凑合着用了。

6D3AEA8FA4A947FF9F16FE6D7F02596F.source: They say Amberfield's mills are turning. Mine's next. She's next, isn't she?
6D3AEA8FA4A947FF9F16FE6D7F02596F.target: 听说琥珀原的风车都转起来了。下一个就是我的。我那风车是下一个，对吧？

6DEF30B7C55F5625C8CD3214F074B80A.source: You asked me for one more night, Linnet. I am a bell-founder. I made it last.
6DEF30B7C55F5625C8CD3214F074B80A.target: 你求我再多给你一夜，琳内特。我是个铸钟匠。我把它铸得长长久久。

6E14B357EF73D44E6D520FCC4376467A.source: Saltcombe. I came here once to sell a fox fur. The harbour master fined me for the smell.
6E14B357EF73D44E6D520FCC4376467A.target: 盐谷镇。我来过一回，卖一张狐狸皮。港务长嫌那股味儿，罚了我的款。

6EA3DEBB5AE2F0B313AC84C33956A6F1.target: ♪ ……转回吧，小潮水……金黄吧，小麦田…… ♪

6F42793D49F87127B5EB32A4FD70F884.source: Light the fires first. Then them.

07A4EE3EEB60D4F746547516ACD06F4B.source: Saltcombe's harbour master keeps a tally of what the frost has cost her harbour. She means to collect.
07A4EE3EEB60D4F746547516ACD06F4B.target: 盐谷镇的港务长记着一笔账：这场霜冻让她的港口亏了多少。她打算一笔一笔讨回来。

7B3105FA5CC8826F7F3B1D3B8AB9797E.source: Empty racks. Every halberd in Rimeholt is out walking.
7B3105FA5CC8826F7F3B1D3B8AB9797E.target: 兵器架空空如也。雾凇堡的每一柄长戟都出门溜达去了。

7BBCB1C5FF4F14E75ABE71CDE53FC787.source: Somebody tuned these chimes. Bronze does what it was cast to do.
7BBCB1C5FF4F14E75ABE71CDE53FC787.target: 有人给这些钟铃调过音。青铜铸来做什么，就做什么。

7C08F75459B25A23376E95EBBBC275C4.source: It stood where I should have stood.
7C08F75459B25A23376E95EBBBC275C4.target: 它站在了本该是我站的地方。

7C9BE6D93A681C7BBAB95CCEE0FA2F00.source: HARBOUR OFFICE. Fees payable in advance. Complaints payable in advance.
7C9BE6D93A681C7BBAB95CCEE0FA2F00.target: 港务所。各项费用须预付。投诉亦须预付。

7C67DFA011C799CEBD216E7B35D6DC3C.source: No. That's what makes it a good price.
7C67DFA011C799CEBD216E7B35D6DC3C.target: 不知道。所以才是个好价钱嘛。

7CE552962EA419CEB73FAB0B2B44C2B0.source: That's a scarecrow. Why is it the size of a barn?
7CE552962EA419CEB73FAB0B2B44C2B0.target: 那是个稻草人。它怎么有谷仓那么大？

7D4A25FCCCCCA4A36C35E2D8669E4F33.source: Salt. Mostly salt, and boats, and one very large fish.
7D4A25FCCCCCA4A36C35E2D8669E4F33.target: 是盐。大多是盐，还有船，外加一条特别大的鱼。

7E0C4F974B3332B9A0CD750F636F7489.source: I tell her what I remember. Flowers, rain, the smell of cut grass. Some of it I make up. She'll not know the difference till she sees it.
7E0C4F974B3332B9A0CD750F636F7489.target: 我把记得的都讲给她听。花、雨、刚割过的青草味儿。有些是我编的。等她亲眼见了，才分得出哪些是真的。

7EBC68DE7043EF24FF8ECEB054E73414.source: ♪ Turn, little tide… gold, little field… rest, little— ♪
7EBC68DE7043EF24FF8ECEB054E73414.target: ♪ 转回吧，小潮水……金黄吧，小麦田……安睡吧，小—— ♪

7FD449C7B89637130442527BAC6184DE.source: Where the Bell of Waking hangs

7FEFD6C97E34C09471ACC7BD90BD86A0.source: I remember now, Mam. All of it. …I'm sorry.
7FEFD6C97E34C09471ACC7BD90BD86A0.target: 我想起来了，妈。全都想起来了。……对不起。

8A4C30FD032ADB0934B69DBDCDF8CBB5.source: Grandda used to say a bell's only a question you can hear across a valley. So. Let's ask one.
8A4C30FD032ADB0934B69DBDCDF8CBB5.target: 外公常说，钟不过是一句隔着山谷也听得见的问话。那好。我们就来问一句。

8A4E2301E36F1838AFC85C8CA4D73143.source: Linnet! Gran says flowers are like snow, only they come up instead of down! Have you ever seen one?
8A4E2301E36F1838AFC85C8CA4D73143.target: 琳内特！阿婆说，花就像雪一样，只不过不是往下落，是往上长！你见过花吗？

8AF07846858D073603992A5FD1B28CDB.source: Hear the beat in it? That bell's been tuned against itself. On purpose.
8AF07846858D073603992A5FD1B28CDB.target: 听出里头的颤音了吗？那口钟被调得跟自己作对。是故意的。

8B9F6CE4D810477B36E765533B5602B5.source: Three chimes rung, and the hill's still shut. Maybe it wants a fourth. Maybe it wants a fee.
8B9F6CE4D810477B36E765533B5602B5.target: 三座钟铃都敲过了，山上还是关着。也许它想要第四座。也许它想收点费。

8B7140713D7B3F03DAAA0C3876A08987.source: Fish! Fresh fish! Well — fish. Seven years in a barrel of ice, they're fresher than I am.
8B7140713D7B3F03DAAA0C3876A08987.target: 鱼！新鲜的鱼！呃——反正是鱼。在冰桶里待了七年，比我还新鲜呢。

8C8A82780AA07D50034408A5671373AD.source: Race you to the island! …Oh. You've got a hammer. Never mind.
8C8A82780AA07D50034408A5671373AD.target: 看谁先跑到岛上！……哦。你拿着锤子呢。那算了。

8CB15DD04B2B4A1CBD7D9295181ACA3F.source: Wake first. Then turn. Then gold. Even I've got it now.
8CB15DD04B2B4A1CBD7D9295181ACA3F.target: 先“醒”，再“转”，然后“金”。连我都记住了。

8CFBAC24A255D3E73B10D39969C6EA92.source: Osmund Halloway's tuning fork. It gives one note, low and long. The Bellkeeper's.
8CFBAC24A255D3E73B10D39969C6EA92.target: 奥斯蒙德·哈洛韦的音叉。它只发一个音，低沉而悠长。守钟人之物。

8D22FDF53C381BF30FEF2F7152D5550D.source: Mind the snares. Some of them are mine, and the bears are getting clever.
8D22FDF53C381BF30FEF2F7152D5550D.target: 当心套子呀。有几个是我下的，再说熊也越来越精了。

8E3D923EC94E733A88FB6B5074F41C34.source: In a neat harbour hand: "One kraken, removed. Paid: no." Signed, M. Gale, Harbour Master.
8E3D923EC94E733A88FB6B5074F41C34.target: 用港务所那种工整的字迹写着：“海怪一头，已清除。已付：否。”署名：M. 盖尔，港务长。

8E632F51A3251E8043D25FEA0EE3E8AC.source: Inside, a kettle is already on. Mother Yarrow did not waste a minute.
8E632F51A3251E8043D25FEA0EE3E8AC.target: 屋里的水壶已经烧上了。亚罗大娘一分钟也没耽搁。

8F599DA5245E6FBC5701FBF6C0B5335C.source: J — strike · K — roll clear · L — lock on
8F599DA5245E6FBC5701FBF6C0B5335C.target: J——攻击 · K——翻滚闪避 · L——锁定

9ACFB782784FAA85E3188A7960F14A41.source: My drift's gone — by the woodpile. I buried a little something under it, seven winters back.
9ACFB782784FAA85E3188A7960F14A41.target: 柴堆边上我那堆雪没了。七个冬天以前，我在它底下埋了点小玩意儿。

9BA22EB7888D8E6BACB5AAEFCE974080.source: Then ring your bell, bell-founder, and let's see what it does.
9BA22EB7888D8E6BACB5AAEFCE974080.target: 那就去敲你的钟吧，铸钟匠，看看它会怎么样。

9BDB2871BF9CD1FCC3D43C36854854DA.source: The door is barred from inside. Nobody has lifted the bar in seven years.
9BDB2871BF9CD1FCC3D43C36854854DA.target: 门从里面闩上了。七年来，没人抬起过门闩。

9C53A429FA9F6F5C163EBB4D1F4B948D.source: Afternoon, Brother! We're after the abbey bell, and I was just telling these two about the time I wrestled a—
9C53A429FA9F6F5C163EBB4D1F4B948D.target: 修士，下午好啊！我们是来找修道院那口钟的，我正跟这两位讲我当年徒手摔翻一头——

9C96E1E4B4335BF4C8FA982A635454F8.source: Grandda's tuning fork hung on this hook every night of his life. It went where he went.
9C96E1E4B4335BF4C8FA982A635454F8.target: 外公这辈子，每天晚上都把音叉挂在这个钩子上。他走到哪儿，它就跟到哪儿。

9D85FF4F5187435A7BEB3CA3A847B652.source: I'm going to let it be morning.

9D434A215332946B6AC8EFF76FEE5F34.source: A Hushguard: old belfry armour, empty, frost in every joint. It has stood here since the bells fell silent. The children dare each other to touch it.
9D434A215332946B6AC8EFF76FEE5F34.target: 一具寂静卫士：钟楼的旧盔甲，里面是空的，每个关节都结着霜。自从钟声沉寂，它就一直站在这里。孩子们总互相怂恿着去摸它一下。

9DA4B5E39A7EF5A88A86E4EB39724E35.source: All those mornings of practice. It's perfect. Somebody eat it before I cry.
9DA4B5E39A7EF5A88A86E4EB39724E35.target: 练了那么多个早上。这一个，完美极了。谁快来把它吃了吧，不然我要哭出来了。

9E589A1EBEE54144FE0282E89CA0D42C.source: Go on home, bell-founder. And mind your knight. It listens better than any novice I ever had.
9E589A1EBEE54144FE0282E89CA0D42C.target: 回家去吧，铸钟匠。照看好你的骑士。它可比我带过的哪个见习修士都听得进话。

09F537F550199E877066EA87BE66886B.source: Three mills, and not a breath of wind
09F537F550199E877066EA87BE66886B.target: 三座风车，一丝风也没有

14A74EAA4EF446BB873015B8A5A820AF.source: The year's stopped before, you know. For a fortnight, when I was small. We liked it.
14A74EAA4EF446BB873015B8A5A820AF.target: 我跟你说，以前年也停过一回。我小时候，停了两个礼拜。我们还挺喜欢的。

14D59A34FD84BEA25A29A190549AB73E.source: The well has been a solid block of ice since that night. Somebody has carved a face in it.
14D59A34FD84BEA25A29A190549AB73E.target: 自那晚起，这口井就冻成了一整块冰。有人在冰上刻了一张脸。

14E9EDA8F6EA59E821778B13FD3D5FE3.source: A child's drawing, folded small. Four bells in a row, and a fifth, coloured in black. Under it, in big uneven letters: SO MAM CAN STAY.
14E9EDA8F6EA59E821778B13FD3D5FE3.target: 一幅孩子的画，叠得小小的。四口钟排成一排，还有第五口，涂成了黑色。下面用歪歪扭扭的大字写着：让妈妈留下来。

18DBDC855A6F04BA0FEA2A6665A9157E.source: Look at it. I couldn't have made this up. And I've made up a lot.
18DBDC855A6F04BA0FEA2A6665A9157E.target: 瞧瞧这儿。这我可编不出来。我编过的东西多着呢。

19A4D11A7AA183E473DA46070FD97761.source: A note on the door: "Gone to ring at the knights. Back for vespers. — F." It has been there seven years.
19A4D11A7AA183E473DA46070FD97761.target: 门上有张字条：“去对着骑士摇铃了。晚祷前回来。——F.”字条在那儿贴了七年了。

19B369BB50C7EF2ED8AC0B236D67F728.source: Seven years of names on the board by the door: the boats that went out the night the ice came.
19B369BB50C7EF2ED8AC0B236D67F728.target: 门边的木牌上挂了七年的名字：都是结冰那晚出海的船。

23B877B60FC9C3CBBEE760522A20DCA3.source: ♪ Wake, little blossom, the frost's letting go… ♪
23B877B60FC9C3CBBEE760522A20DCA3.target: ♪ 醒来吧，小花苞，冰花正松手…… ♪

29E97E049DB1160476291D4F39DEA0B2.source: In chalk: THE WEST BELL RANG. AND THE SOUTH ONE.
29E97E049DB1160476291D4F39DEA0B2.target: 粉笔写的：西边的钟响了。南边的也响了。

34DA4996007A2B5DF830D0F8BF36EFF6.source: In chalk, in a child's round hand: THE WEST BELL RANG.
34DA4996007A2B5DF830D0F8BF36EFF6.target: 粉笔写的，孩子圆圆的字迹：西边的钟响了。

36E9780688C941C4C23A630CE68A97BD.source: Barrels stacked to the rafters. Years of barrels, and nothing to put in them.
36E9780688C941C4C23A630CE68A97BD.target: 木桶一直堆到房梁。攒了好几年的桶，却没有东西可装。

38C1EFA47EE528EAD53518D787BB7A96.source: You've snow on your shoulders again.

039FD556D6244F582F2E1D92A25BA5CB.source: The Bell of Waking hangs in the shrine on the hill of the Blossomwood, west along the road from Bell Street. Spring is waiting under the snow there.
039FD556D6244F582F2E1D92A25BA5CB.target: 苏醒之钟挂在繁花林山上的神祠里，从钟街沿路往西走。那里的春天，正在雪底下等着。

40F82067E96F9766A3F19C30D47AE685.source: The fishermen were right. I hate it when fishermen are right.
40F82067E96F9766A3F19C30D47AE685.target: 渔夫们说对了。我最讨厌渔夫说对的时候。

41EAB4F305D21EDF3115F7DD9D5F2F27.source: Truer. As if it heard the west bell too.
41EAB4F305D21EDF3115F7DD9D5F2F27.target: 准了些。好像它也听见了西边的钟。

43EFB00CDA4EC57E0E7F608319DE438C.source: Seven years I've told that story about the man in the snow. Seven years of "yes, Corin". I'd like to be wrong, for once.
43EFB00CDA4EC57E0E7F608319DE438C.target: 雪地里那个人的故事，我讲了七年。七年来听到的全是“是是是，科林”。这一回，我倒宁愿是我错了。

43F507C10B304B1F9BA76396D3EF50C3.source: Mark me — it'll turn. I've a knee for weather, and it's itched since your first bell.
43F507C10B304B1F9BA76396D3EF50C3.target: 你记着——它会转的。我这膝盖看天气准着呢，打你敲响头一口钟起，它就一直发痒。

44CB964823CCDFC7318399803DCE6221.source: I light them every evening. It's always evening. You do the sums.
44CB964823CCDFC7318399803DCE6221.target: 我每天傍晚点灯。可现在永远是傍晚。你自己算吧。

047D5C57C1AB7BD09C3AD4E228F75AEC.source: Wall's gone, sun's up, nothing to watch. Might take up fishing. Nettle says she'll teach me. Heaven help me.
047D5C57C1AB7BD09C3AD4E228F75AEC.target: 墙没了，太阳出来了，没什么可守的了。也许去钓钓鱼。内特尔说她来教我。老天保佑。

049A69F7489D7E2A8C35501AEDD56832.source: Its helm is turned toward the square now. It was not, this morning.
049A69F7489D7E2A8C35501AEDD56832.target: 它的头盔现在朝着广场。今早还不是这样。

052C4EC1789CBB05F24B0EC9BE0EFE6C.source: Wenna tears the receipt in half, and in half again, and lets the pieces go with the petals.
052C4EC1789CBB05F24B0EC9BE0EFE6C.target: 温娜把收据撕成两半，再撕成两半，让碎片随着花瓣飘走。

52E02EFBF79016A95E5FA84127DD5E75.source: You hit a knight! With a hammer! Do it again, I wasn't looking at the start!
52E02EFBF79016A95E5FA84127DD5E75.target: 你打了骑士！用锤子！再来一次，开头我没看见！

53F3BC108FCDB6B5644BF9D250BACDC0.source: Gold to the hedges. I rang this little bell for seven years so I'd not forget what that sound was for.
53F3BC108FCDB6B5644BF9D250BACDC0.target: 金灿灿的，一直铺到树篱边。这只小铃我摇了七年，为的是别忘了这声音本来是为什么响的。

54C2BD4729D9E73E5ABD2F6C3152349A.source: When I'm big I'm going to see a summer. Gran says they're mostly flies, but I don't mind.
54C2BD4729D9E73E5ABD2F6C3152349A.target: 等我长大了，我要去看一回夏天。阿婆说夏天大多是苍蝇，可我不在乎。

54FAB1EB76732B9DEF50B4DD22969F2D.source: Stowaways. Every one of you owes passage!
54FAB1EB76732B9DEF50B4DD22969F2D.target: 偷渡客。你们一个个都欠着船费！

55DDAD84177B4A0DD947FF11B66FFE61.source: When you're ready, sparrow. I've waited seven years. I can wait a little longer.
55DDAD84177B4A0DD947FF11B66FFE61.target: 等你准备好了再来吧，小麻雀。我已经等了七年，再多等一会儿也不要紧。

56DBA1618D1132450691B66996A8C164.source: Wake, little blossom… turn, little tide… gold, little field. Wake, turn, gold.
56DBA1618D1132450691B66996A8C164.target: 醒来吧，小花苞……转回吧，小潮水……金黄吧，小麦田。醒、转、金。

56EF80924F9FB924A7CA59CD459D4F58.source: The child lit the first one herself. Up the ladder before I'd found my boots.
56EF80924F9FB924A7CA59CD459D4F58.target: 头一盏是那孩子自己点的。我靴子还没找着，她就已经上梯子了。

57C9EA71E9EA6F449ADAD82F1B2D59BA.source: The way to the Bell Court

58D553E8AAE21DE3185CAAC570886056.source: You're telling me somebody tuned a whole wood to a lullaby.
58D553E8AAE21DE3185CAAC570886056.target: 你是说，有人照着一首摇篮曲给整片林子调了音？

60A6B0ADC85AEB21359211AE210CEF11.source: And you've gone nowhere, you great lump.
60A6B0ADC85AEB21359211AE210CEF11.target: 你倒好，哪儿都没去，你这傻大个。

064BC9088C877D6CBC28115FACA7D8AE.source: Not yet. Not till I know what I'm going for.
064BC9088C877D6CBC28115FACA7D8AE.target: 还不行。得先弄清楚我是去做什么的。

64C8D4A471E1BD705C9E0E95CF9921AA.source: Sing her the end of it, Da.
64C8D4A471E1BD705C9E0E95CF9921AA.target: 爸，把最后一句唱给她听吧。

64E136C097A63BDC0205CF01E5AC9EC8.source: Gran says when it's spring here I'm to make a crown of everything. You'll have to help. I don't know what everything is yet.
64E136C097A63BDC0205CF01E5AC9EC8.target: 阿婆说，等这里到了春天，我要编一顶什么都有的花冠。你得帮我。我还不知道“什么都有”都有些什么呢。

65A88D3BE005F7EFDB9AF760C5A56F71.source: You set it on the road.

65B23B2E5D6952516B4BB5C7C0D4822B.source: I gave the tin knight flowers. It didn't say thank you, but it never says anything.
65B23B2E5D6952516B4BB5C7C0D4822B.target: 我送了锡骑士一束花。它没说谢谢，不过它本来就什么都不说嘛。

65D304724366F31C28095DDF7DFE9D4A.source: A Hushguard: old belfry armour, empty, frost in every joint. It has stood here since the bells fell silent. The children dare each other to touch it.
65D304724366F31C28095DDF7DFE9D4A.target: 一具寂静卫士：钟楼的旧盔甲，里面是空的，每个关节都结着霜。自从钟声沉寂，它就一直站在这里。孩子们总互相怂恿着去摸它一下。

69E7DE5F32A3D58CF53E8EF79352D3CB.source: Where the Bell of Harvest hangs

70CF989EF6A799E22F8EDC077E4E1A88.source: Not forever. That's the point of them, I think.
70CF989EF6A799E22F8EDC077E4E1A88.target: 留不了永远。我想，花好就好在这儿。

71C1A454071FCAF2CACE66704B195D0B.source: That's not a garrison. That's a choir.
71C1A454071FCAF2CACE66704B195D0B.target: 那不是守军。那是唱诗班。

71DAC091CB2141FF356B8F75C5D6CB92.source: The pilot's house. Her charts of the bay are pinned to the shutters — iced over, every one.
71DAC091CB2141FF356B8F75C5D6CB92.target: 领航员的家。她画的海湾海图钉在百叶窗上——每一张都结了冰。

71FFBD8E462542C30069E8AAABE83EFE.source: Seven fires. I'll want a receipt.
71FFBD8E462542C30069E8AAABE83EFE.target: 七个火盆了。我得要张收据。

72A2FBF531CF4221B09FC75CC6716603.source: A notice on the door: NO MEETING THIS WEEK. Under it, older: NO MEETING THIS WEEK.
72A2FBF531CF4221B09FC75CC6716603.target: 门上贴着告示：本周不开会。下面还有一张更旧的：本周不开会。

74F32A1A8BACC45E33ED8C11DC56A402.source: Linnet Halloway! Are you hurt? What were they?
74F32A1A8BACC45E33ED8C11DC56A402.target: 琳内特·哈洛韦！你受伤没有？那些是什么东西呀？

77F24A99ED605420E44ED69C568081A2.source: Did you fight a kraken? Corin says you fought a kraken. Corin says a lot of things.
77F24A99ED605420E44ED69C568081A2.target: 你跟海怪打过架吗？科林说你跟海怪打过。不过科林说的话多了去了。

78FBECA7343A580764580095F3FEB452.source: Two! Cobb lit that one. He says he's a professional and I'm not allowed.
78FBECA7343A580764580095F3FEB452.target: 两盏啦！那盏是科布点的。他说他是专业的，不许我点。

80BF0699C776168743F3D852221E5390.source: We sat down to eat, and the light never moved. The others went to Evermere when the cold set in. I stayed with the supper.
80BF0699C776168743F3D852221E5390.target: 我们坐下吃饭，天光就再没动过。天一冷，别人都去了永湖镇。我留下来守着这顿晚饭。

81D559A7F86FABA4D2FDB349B4F2AE71.source: The Knight at the Forge Door

83CFD61F06A11EA40B2AA0DB024E0A8D.source: The smell of fish has outlasted the fish. Impressive, in its way.
83CFD61F06A11EA40B2AA0DB024E0A8D.target: 鱼早就没了，鱼腥味却还在。也算是一种本事。

86B0899198EEB58A980692EE944E6424.source: Seven years I sat in Evermere with my hands in my lap, listening for that bell. And then — there it was. Clear as morning.
86B0899198EEB58A980692EE944E6424.target: 七年来，我在永湖镇坐着，两手搁在膝上，就等着听那口钟响。后来——它真的响了。清亮得像早晨一样。

86DE63212FF77A656B8AFBD1CE20DD21.source: The mills went still the same night. Hit one on the hub, if you've the arm for it. They always did need a kick to start.
86DE63212FF77A656B8AFBD1CE20DD21.target: 风车也是那天晚上停的。你要是有那把力气，就朝轴心敲上一下。它们向来得踹一脚才肯转。

87A6FDB06D91E4D4DF9B53E312B48180.source: Bar six nights I was down with the ague. I've billed myself for those.
87A6FDB06D91E4D4DF9B53E312B48180.target: 只有六晚没点，那几天我打摆子病倒了。那六晚，我给自己开了账单。

87AF15969B89071A82C97BFCE688D9D5.source: Noted. One confession, unpaid. I'll put it under sundries.
87AF15969B89071A82C97BFCE688D9D5.target: 记下了。坦白一桩，未付。归入杂项。

88E9D082926A48D3E8B2774749B3C80F.source: You were ten. A debt that old, the harbour writes off. Ring it, love.
88E9D082926A48D3E8B2774749B3C80F.target: 你那时才十岁。这么老的账，港口一笔勾销。敲吧，丫头。

89BC687F1F0C92777F6DC5AE92FE9E48.source: It's wearing a coat. Who dresses a scarecrow in a good coat?
89BC687F1F0C92777F6DC5AE92FE9E48.target: 它还穿着件大衣。谁会给稻草人穿件好大衣？

090DC39E99484B42CC5643E3CE63DEF9.source: Two bells. The ice on the gate's gone grey at the edges. Like a beard. Like mine.
090DC39E99484B42CC5643E3CE63DEF9.target: 两口钟了。门上的冰，边上发灰了。像胡子。跟我的一样。

94D1394602282AC38DF05823F95FDACE.source: Thousands. White, mostly, and pink at the edges. They smell like a clean shirt.
94D1394602282AC38DF05823F95FDACE.target: 成千上万。大多是白的，边上带点粉。闻起来像刚洗干净的衬衫。

94E6664275A2C82FBF6BE8458B7A18DD.source: The bridge went in the first winter. Mind the edge.
94E6664275A2C82FBF6BE8458B7A18DD.target: 桥在头一个冬天就塌了。小心崖边。

94E21402652E5FF943820583F5B7F7E0.source: You're telling me somebody tuned a whole wood to a lullaby.
94E21402652E5FF943820583F5B7F7E0.target: 你是说，有人照着一首摇篮曲给整片林子调了音？

097A0D0E486470324A142517BA7C97AC.2.source: the Stag of the Waking Wood

97E63568D865FC653E9E7DF0319E9579.source: He's snuffing the fires! Light them again, quick!
97E63568D865FC653E9E7DF0319E9579.target: 他把火都掐灭了！快，重新点上！

98BBB980CB6FE551924F570995699C70.source: Did you see Wenna's face when that boat came in? Best thing I've seen since the ice came, and I've seen a bear in a hat.
98BBB980CB6FE551924F570995699C70.target: 那条船进港的时候，你看见温娜的脸没？自从结冰以来，这是我见过最棒的场面——要知道，我可是见过戴帽子的熊呢。

172E878CF16AE475EC47DC927E57E0DA.source: The Bell of Tides is in the lighthouse at Saltcombe, south down the gorge road. The town dug the drift out the day the west bell rang.
172E878CF16AE475EC47DC927E57E0DA.target: 潮汐之钟在盐谷镇的灯塔里，顺着峡谷路往南走。西边的钟响起那天，镇上的人把雪堆挖通了。

238B06411F37B55DECE1ED3AE21F7720.source: A Hushguard: old belfry armour, empty, frost in every joint. It has stood here since the bells fell silent. The children dare each other to touch it.
238B06411F37B55DECE1ED3AE21F7720.target: 一具寂静卫士：钟楼的旧盔甲，里面是空的，每个关节都结着霜。自从钟声沉寂，它就一直站在这里。孩子们总互相怂恿着去摸它一下。

304B7084D9F93D8A334737D9F7F9C373.source: The Bell of Rest waits at Rimeholt, at the head of the valley, past the Frost Gate. So does Grandda.
304B7084D9F93D8A334737D9F7F9C373.target: 安眠之钟在山谷尽头的雾凇堡等着，过了霜之门就是。外公也在那儿。

313F21D3F81E009299828C0B50FA481A.source: Tidy forge. Your grandfather kept accounts, I'd wager. A man who hangs every tool on its own hook keeps accounts.
313F21D3F81E009299828C0B50FA481A.target: 铸钟坊收拾得挺齐整。我敢打赌，你外公记账。每样工具都挂在自己钩子上的人，准记账。

333CBF51E114510EA1F5C6016294156F.source: Gold, little field, for the reapers are home… Rest, little year—
333CBF51E114510EA1F5C6016294156F.target: 金黄吧，小麦田，割麦人回家……安睡吧，小年年——

355EDDF570C24B01D0C381B29D482259.target: Luminati 2.5D 像素艺术引擎 · three.js

392DBC16E8539499B5818C6DC64DE74B.source: My hands shake on the hammer now. Yours don't. That's as it should be.
392DBC16E8539499B5818C6DC64DE74B.target: 我握锤子的手如今会抖了。你的不会。这样才对。

403AFDD6C72CF9BBE8DC76D50BFD16C8.source: The Prosper. Wool and brandy for Evermere, seven years overdue. I've a key for every hold in this harbour.
403AFDD6C72CF9BBE8DC76D50BFD16C8.target: 兴旺号。运往永湖镇的羊毛和白兰地，逾期七年了。这港口里每个货舱的钥匙我都有。

432C61663E40CED38D3A88290AF422C3.source: Nothing comes down through that ice. Nothing goes up. I watch it anyway.
432C61663E40CED38D3A88290AF422C3.target: 那道冰墙，什么都下不来，什么也上不去。我照样守着。

439C6A299D3ACE8C0FE7856361DBB479.source: I make it seven. And two of the bell-ringers behind them.
439C6A299D3ACE8C0FE7856361DBB479.target: 我数着是七具。后面还有两个鸣钟者。

465AFEF623F6A4A90F8F31814C5D2DBC.source: ♪ Wake, little blossom, the frog's letting go…
465AFEF623F6A4A90F8F31814C5D2DBC.target: ♪ 醒来吧，小花苞，冰蛙正松手……

469B748BA6043F77AEC3640A08978ED2.source: The 2,578 has been rubbed out with a mitten. Under it, in a child's round hand: SPRING!!!
469B748BA6043F77AEC3640A08978ED2.target: 那个2578被人用连指手套抹掉了。下面是孩子圆圆的字迹：春天来啦！！！

469FA993835F3B9ADBBDC55DA7F7735A.source: Fog cleared, hedge open, knights behind it. I'll invoice the miller.
469FA993835F3B9ADBBDC55DA7F7735A.target: 雾散了，树篱开了，后头还有骑士。这笔账我开给磨坊主。

470F892584693F79D0AE515108D6F3F1.source: I've closed the ledger. First time it's balanced since the ice. I don't know what to do with my evenings.
470F892584693F79D0AE515108D6F3F1.target: 我把账本合上了。自从结冰以来，头一回收支两平。晚上都不知道该干什么好了。

487DF1D93605F4337760EE4CA480315C.source: A bridge under the drift. Roots, grown across on purpose.
487DF1D93605F4337760EE4CA480315C.target: 雪堆底下有座桥。树根是特意引着长过去的。

492E37CE20A044CEC7004F8864407FEB.source: One brazier's worth of coal. Billed to the King.
492E37CE20A044CEC7004F8864407FEB.target: 煤一火盆。记在国王账上。

00492F4FD3DB19F280C3D5F186AE70F7.source: Up past the chimes, past the falls, past whatever's been living on that hill since the frost came. You'll want a guide.
00492F4FD3DB19F280C3D5F186AE70F7.target: 一路往上，过钟铃，过瀑布，还得过山上那玩意儿——自从霜冻降临，也不知是什么东西一直盘踞在那儿。你得有个向导呀。

512C27BC45EEF1EC3F90BE8E54D09E46.source: The sails are turning. That's all this one has to give.
512C27BC45EEF1EC3F90BE8E54D09E46.target: 风车转起来了。这一座能给的就这些。

517A24795F30D4778EBE14FEFFF22C35.source: A crown of everything, when spring comes to Evermere.
517A24795F30D4778EBE14FEFFF22C35.target: 等春天来到永湖镇，编一顶什么都有的花冠。

535F5E04657D060D74FB309FABBF97A4.source: It's Grandda's coat. These burns on the cuffs — that's bell-metal. He never would wear gloves.
535F5E04657D060D74FB309FABBF97A4.target: 是外公的大衣。袖口上这些烧痕——是钟铜烫的。他从来不肯戴手套。

554B85172ADD64DD6797F7DBF4E29325.source: Then they'll be wanting a founder.

561BE8996D1A052B4D6A891E92E4468A.source: Do you know what a bell's worth of bronze weighs?
561BE8996D1A052B4D6A891E92E4468A.target: 你知道一口钟的青铜有多重吗？

575DF8030F6943FEEE753A17EF7B2CCB.source: There was a hollow behind the ice all along.
575DF8030F6943FEEE753A17EF7B2CCB.target: 原来冰后面一直有个凹洞。

599F001E2C16AFD2F20ED5487FE55492.source: Every word of it's true. Most of the words, anyway.
599F001E2C16AFD2F20ED5487FE55492.target: 每个字都是真的。好吧，大部分字是。

609AD190C780A081FF5558A9B4B43630.source: A sprig of the Blossomwood's first blossom in seven years. Dilly has never seen one.
609AD190C780A081FF5558A9B4B43630.target: 一小枝樱花，繁花林七年来开的头一茬花。迪莉还从没见过花。

649E39BA6C67E508C74DB47E41D50B91.source: Every spring, till I was ten. …I can't remember the colour.
649E39BA6C67E508C74DB47E41D50B91.target: 十岁以前，每年春天都见。……我记不起是什么颜色了。

698E7BC6E2982993DB1FF94F7161B297.source: Stay by the fire when it rings.

709FB7D7A90330AED5F9E054D25DF6DC.source: Dilly's going to want one of these.

713CF53905864BD5CFAC4B1A1B1B345A.source: The shrine gate is open. Something waits in the glade beneath the Bell of Waking.
713CF53905864BD5CFAC4B1A1B1B345A.target: 神祠的大门开了。苏醒之钟下方的林地里，有什么东西在等着。

740AB65949EB9E4AD7D84A944D012077.2.source: Gold, little field, for the reapers are home
740AB65949EB9E4AD7D84A944D012077.2.target: 金黄吧，小麦田，割麦人回家

746E47ACEF4B918B04B218F87C1B9877.source: Still flat. Grandda could tune a bell by ear in an afternoon. Seven years, and I've got this far.
746E47ACEF4B918B04B218F87C1B9877.target: 还是走音。外公凭耳朵，一个下午就能把一口钟调准。七年了，我才到这一步。

772D2C8AF274AEC31E36E1DF5B6DB420.source: Its helm is turned toward the square now. It was not, this morning.
772D2C8AF274AEC31E36E1DF5B6DB420.target: 它的头盔现在朝着广场。今早还不是这样。

800A126C13328C21C1B35D7D5E4B0D40.source: The harbour's got its master back. And I've an invoice to deliver, soon as I find out who it's made out to.
800A126C13328C21C1B35D7D5E4B0D40.target: 港口又有人当家了。我这儿还有张账单要送，就等弄清楚抬头该写谁了。

819E1018476644D60E4187E02F4B581E.source: Three bells. Number 2,578, iced. I've a feeling about tomorrow's. Don't you laugh.
819E1018476644D60E4187E02F4B581E.target: 三口钟啦。第2578个，抹了糖霜。明天那个呀，我有种预感。你可别笑话我。

833F681391E1D2AD5E2A00DC0432F871.source: Wenna says the chandler went to Evermere and married a baker. That can't be right. He hated bread.
833F681391E1D2AD5E2A00DC0432F871.target: 温娜说，那个船具商去了永湖镇，娶了个面包师。不可能吧。他最讨厌面包了。

897CE414424BF4CE46E938B236A65546.source: A loom clacks inside, slow and patient. Whatever it is, it is very long by now.
897CE414424BF4CE46E938B236A65546.target: 屋里的织机咔嗒作响，缓慢而耐心。不管织的是什么，到如今想必已经很长很长了。

932B90DF47D1C4151A3EE116D54E4FDE.source: Dilly is seven. She has never seen a season. She wants something from each edge of the valley.
932B90DF47D1C4151A3EE116D54E4FDE.target: 迪莉七岁了。她一个季节也没见过。她想从山谷的每一边各要一样东西。

950A443931569FD3A40D45CA8D780066.source: Ships. Stuck in the ice like flies in amber. Seven years, and not one of them has rotted.
950A443931569FD3A40D45CA8D780066.target: 船。卡在冰里，像琥珀里的苍蝇。七年了，一艘都没烂。

1241E197947E267548E625A68DFB0336.source: You're quiet, Halloway. Quiet costs extra. Talk to me.
1241E197947E267548E625A68DFB0336.target: 你话少了，哈洛韦。沉默要另外收费。跟我说说话。

1415FC8BF825157FC3641C5ECF17A75F.source: Buds. Every one of them shut tight under the ice, like a casting left too long in the mould.
1415FC8BF825157FC3641C5ECF17A75F.target: 花苞。每一个都被冰封得死死的，像在模子里闷得太久的铸件。

1613F1B0B9004A0A28790090D1365FE0.source: Ships in the ice, like flies in amber

02169C44DD5953280A4B6161F051D6B3.source: Jory's asked after three girls who married other men and a dog that's dead. I tell him one a day. It's cheaper.
02169C44DD5953280A4B6161F051D6B3.target: 乔里打听了三个早就嫁给别人的姑娘，还有一条早死了的狗。我一天只告诉他一件。这样划算。

2365FCD2989A570FCE9EE61B45F41DAF.source: The Knight at the Forge Door

2935D88BB2BDE520A75CCB8190A17D8A.source: Three bells! I've been practising on the well with a stick. Forty hits. It hasn't rung once.
2935D88BB2BDE520A75CCB8190A17D8A.target: 三口钟！我一直拿根棍子敲井练习呢。敲了四十下。一下都没响！

3532C9A803900A18EA6555655BCFC25C.source: That's not a smell. …Bring me a seashell next. From the sea. Gran says it's south.
3532C9A803900A18EA6555655BCFC25C.target: 那才不是味道呢。……下次给我带个贝壳吧。从海里带。阿婆说海在南边。

4145B64221771864267D938BD0A3026A.source: Wake, little blossom… turn, little tide… gold, little field. Wake, turn, gold.
4145B64221771864267D938BD0A3026A.target: 醒来吧，小花苞……转回吧，小潮水……金黄吧，小麦田。醒、转、金。

4223E58F89782A19425DC7BB9D18316B.source: Somebody has to keep the places laid. When they come home, they'll want to know where to sit.
4223E58F89782A19425DC7BB9D18316B.target: 总得有人把碗筷摆好嘛。等他们回了家，总得知道自己坐哪儿。

4347BE94BC45F96A7843EE7C92B1E25D.source: Sit down, sit down. The pie's seven years cold and still the best in the valley.
4347BE94BC45F96A7843EE7C92B1E25D.target: 坐，坐。这馅饼凉了七年，还是山谷里最好的。

5000E7D86E0F2DCCA38711F22142D7C6.source: And you. The fox fur. I never forget a smell.
5000E7D86E0F2DCCA38711F22142D7C6.target: 还有你。狐狸皮那个。什么味儿我都忘不了。

5013F6288CECF3AD033196A95FE183B9.source: Ringers first. The cantors mend the knights; a knight with no cantor is only armour with an opinion.
5013F6288CECF3AD033196A95FE183B9.target: 先对付鸣钟者。咏者会修好骑士；没了咏者，骑士不过是一副有主见的盔甲。

5126B7B45D255778283F5D335117CF25.source: A Hushguard: old belfry armour, empty, frost in every joint. It has stood here since the bells fell silent. The children dare each other to touch it.
5126B7B45D255778283F5D335117CF25.target: 一具寂静卫士：钟楼的旧盔甲，里面是空的，每个关节都结着霜。自从钟声沉寂，它就一直站在这里。孩子们总互相怂恿着去摸它一下。

5151E4E1C606ADE04FF776E2787390FE.source: Its helm is turned toward the square now. It was not, this morning.
5151E4E1C606ADE04FF776E2787390FE.target: 它的头盔现在朝着广场。今早还不是这样。

6973C4651E6115917B8C8C277302EE73.source: The Patience is home, and Jory with her, seven years late and not a day older. Wenna has an invoice for whoever stopped the year.
6973C4651E6115917B8C8C277302EE73.target: 耐心号回港了，乔里也跟着回来了，晚了七年，却一天也没老。温娜备好了一张账单，要交给让这一年停住的那个人。

7008DBA72B1A6D4B4A07EE10CD714870.source: In chalk: THE WEST BELL RANG. AND THE SOUTH ONE. EAST TOO!!!
7008DBA72B1A6D4B4A07EE10CD714870.target: 粉笔写的：西边的钟响了。南边的也响了。东边也响啦！！！

7720B1DB5BD3D4E16EEB63BE7EAC8E8C.source: The Knight at the Forge Door

08093F5D1642708D5C648DDE7B6A9FC8.source: The west bell rang, and the wall up there sang back. Never heard it do that.
08093F5D1642708D5C648DDE7B6A9FC8.target: 西边的钟一响，上头那道墙就跟着唱了起来。从没听它这样过。

8676E403060FB9B10A641DC7D96595EA.source: Its helm is turned toward the square now. It was not, this morning.
8676E403060FB9B10A641DC7D96595EA.target: 它的头盔现在朝着广场。今早还不是这样。

9362FBDAEF5A313E4152F911ECA4BF85.source: Three lanterns. I've started a fourth. Optimism, the child calls it.
9362FBDAEF5A313E4152F911ECA4BF85.target: 三盏了。第四盏我已经动手做了。那孩子管这叫“乐观”。

9377D55DCBB2B23262FCE0FA13FC9C07.source: Bears use roads. Everybody uses roads. That's what makes them roads.
9377D55DCBB2B23262FCE0FA13FC9C07.target: 熊也走路嘛。谁都走路。所以才叫路啊。

9631D691C9E69DCE2A71726F95863BB4.source: Seven years that water's been holding its breath. Hark at it go.
9631D691C9E69DCE2A71726F95863BB4.target: 这水整整憋了七年气。听听它这股劲儿。

21498CED57480762DB91B425B1709CC1.source: The grass is GREEN. Gran didn't make it up. Gran didn't make ANY of it up.
21498CED57480762DB91B425B1709CC1.target: 草是绿的！阿婆没有瞎编。阿婆说的，一点儿都没瞎编！

21555E80C2D7514ECA86D777ED3EF7FE.source: Three lanterns. I've been telling that child stories about spring since she could talk. She likes yours better.
21555E80C2D7514ECA86D777ED3EF7FE.target: 三盏灯了。那孩子打会说话起，我就给她讲春天的故事。她更喜欢你讲的。

25644EE86D18D885FF660F35269B151A.source: We're in the middle. We go last.
25644EE86D18D885FF660F35269B151A.target: 我们在正中间。我们排最后。

28780D8D87E4D1DFD12FEF4D93E1346A.source: I stood at your door seven winters, and walked beside you from the abbey. Corin tells me you hit him with a hammer.
28780D8D87E4D1DFD12FEF4D93E1346A.target: 我在你家门口站了七个冬天，又从修道院一路走在你身边。科林跟我说，你用锤子打过他。

35936BB3F046552C85F0C8343196F79C.source: …Oh. There it is. Hello, dear. Does it eat cake?
35936BB3F046552C85F0C8343196F79C.target: ……哎呀，它在这儿呢。你好呀，亲爱的。它吃蛋糕吗？

43227DC6BF1126C52A705A7FF39AFE38.source: Tell her it's only one night.
43227DC6BF1126C52A705A7FF39AFE38.target: 跟她说，只是一个晚上而已。

43465D418DAD6E4C29C5077C70D5E50F.source: The town has dug the gorge road out. The way south to Saltcombe is open.
43465D418DAD6E4C29C5077C70D5E50F.target: 镇上的人把峡谷路挖通了。往南去盐谷镇的路开通了。

47013EEA9B37BF439B90E47E8EB30BC1.source: I'm the harbour master. Somebody has to keep the books.
47013EEA9B37BF439B90E47E8EB30BC1.target: 我是港务长。总得有人记账。

47978D2E3280E3440105C9C70687CD5E.source: I lit the second lantern. Professional job. The child's not allowed up ladders after the first one.
47978D2E3280E3440105C9C70687CD5E.target: 第二盏灯是我点的。专业活儿。自打头一盏之后，那孩子就不许上梯子了。

56500C6193C3B88C521991D3782F6FBF.source: I lit it! Gran held the ladder. We heard it, Linnet — all the way from the west!
56500C6193C3B88C521991D3782F6FBF.target: 是我点的！阿婆扶着梯子。我们听见啦，琳内特——从西边一路传过来的！

67826EA6E47E350EC1AE61AC6CEBE38F.source: Tin strikes the fork on its gauntlet. One note, low and long. Linnet's hand goes to her throat, as if to catch it.
67826EA6E47E350EC1AE61AC6CEBE38F.target: 阿锡在护手上敲响音叉。一个音，低沉而悠长。琳内特的手抬到喉边，像是要把它接住。

72552D8E133E0FD97AB5B4452C7DD4F3.source: Ice shove. Seen one put a wall across Saltcombe harbour in a night. Stand back.
72552D8E133E0FD97AB5B4452C7DD4F3.target: 冰推。我见过一回，一夜之间就在盐谷镇的港口横起一道墙。往后站。

073711B15C683E1DBD31D652BE6A6D7A.source: My brother's boat was out that night. If a bell brings the tide back, it brings the Patience back. Wait there.
073711B15C683E1DBD31D652BE6A6D7A.target: 那晚我弟弟的船还在海上。要是钟声能把潮水带回来，也就能把耐心号带回来。在这儿等着。

78331B0A43E778C9E008884CDDB7D900.source: A shell! It sounds like snow inside. Is the sea made of snow?
78331B0A43E778C9E008884CDDB7D900.target: 贝壳！里面听着像在下雪。大海是雪做的吗？

78861D445BD30E77949546A44751EA1F.source: Seven years I've rung it at them. A bell-note stills them, for a breath. They listen.
78861D445BD30E77949546A44751EA1F.target: 七年来，我一直冲它们摇这铃。铃音一响，它们就会定住一口气的工夫。它们在听。

89492D4F87079EEEE61130D48D8627A0.source: The press still holds its last load of apples — frozen solid, mid-squeeze.
89492D4F87079EEEE61130D48D8627A0.target: 压榨机里还压着最后一批苹果——榨到一半，冻得结结实实。

99628F533A34A8AF1764C846958DB01B.source: You can. And if you can't, I'll tell everyone you did. I'm very convincing.
99628F533A34A8AF1764C846958DB01B.target: 你做得到。就算做不到，我也会告诉所有人你做到了。我说话可是很有说服力的。

0316673FCCBD4D85BAEB1EA76123B2DF.source: That's number 2,557. I bake one every morning. One morning somebody's going to need it.
0316673FCCBD4D85BAEB1EA76123B2DF.target: 这是第2557个了。我每天早上烤一个。总有那么一天早上，有人会用得着它。

417454C44BDB6E7088FB6D8480A2F892.source: Seven years they've stood about this town like coat-stands, and you go and ring the bell at them.
417454C44BDB6E7088FB6D8480A2F892.target: 七年了，它们就像衣帽架似的杵在镇上，你倒好，跑去冲着它们敲钟。

705686EDCF6F3EBE08F482FD1C90383A.source: Oil, wicks, and a ledger. Every night for seven years, one tally mark: a lamp lit. The last page is nearly full.
705686EDCF6F3EBE08F482FD1C90383A.target: 灯油、灯芯，还有一本账本。七年来每晚一道记号：点了一盏灯。最后一页快记满了。

711552E98201E05A84B73813073677A0.source: The road to the Shrine of Waking climbs through the Blossomwood, where three wayside chimes stand frozen in the snow.
711552E98201E05A84B73813073677A0.target: 通往苏醒神祠的路穿过繁花林向上攀去，林中有三座道旁钟铃，冻在雪里。

716633E638E6147138DC7F9A9CDA31FE.source: A cracked bell can be recast. It's still the same bronze.
716633E638E6147138DC7F9A9CDA31FE.target: 裂了的钟可以重铸。铜还是那块铜。

798741E0D6A92A3A7F3E173F58C9A72B.source: Doesn't even blink. Best one we've ever had.
798741E0D6A92A3A7F3E173F58C9A72B.target: 连眼都不眨一下哪。是咱们用过最好的一个。

816035CD9279065DAEA62356DF6D2628.source: Observing. Black as a boot, that night, and a man came up the north road through the storm — tall, a long coat, striking something on his hand. A little fork. Ting. Ting.
816035CD9279065DAEA62356DF6D2628.target: 是在观察。那晚黑得伸手不见五指，有个男人顶着风雪从北边的路上来——个子高高的，穿着长大衣，在手上敲着什么东西。一把小小的叉子。叮。叮。

821534D762A56BA3E20D92A87EBE7850.source: Harbour's closed. Has been since the ice came in. There's a fee for asking.
821534D762A56BA3E20D92A87EBE7850.target: 港口关了。自从结冰以来一直关着。打听也要收费。

0887007CA2AED877783D809519A9D2AC.source: A hut of split logs. Snares hang from every peg — and one rabbit, frozen in mid-escape.
0887007CA2AED877783D809519A9D2AC.target: 一间劈开的原木搭成的小屋。每根木钉上都挂着套索——还有一只兔子，逃到一半就冻住了。

4026794A8E0CB3B624EEAFA2A611EDBB.source: A draught for the road? Brother Fallow blesses them. I mostly just bottle them.
4026794A8E0CB3B624EEAFA2A611EDBB.target: 带瓶治疗药水上路？法洛修士给它们祝过福。我嘛，基本就管装瓶。

4091270AAA5DC37007FACF0C452F1C61.source: I'll be at the square, sparrow. There's something I should have given you a long time ago.
4091270AAA5DC37007FACF0C452F1C61.target: 我在广场等你，小麻雀。有样东西，我早就该给你了。

6566875B293A95FDC8A339400AE6D075.source: I'll take you. For a bell's worth of bronze.
6566875B293A95FDC8A339400AE6D075.target: 我带你去。价钱嘛，一口钟的青铜。

8022428E64A4AFBAE670D68B7FA08634.source: Here — first thing the tide brought in. For luck.
8022428E64A4AFBAE670D68B7FA08634.target: 喏——潮水送来的头一样东西。图个好运。

09350883BA9EB471D3749215F3D3EAB9.source: Seven years of grain, never threshed. It smells of a summer nobody had.
09350883BA9EB471D3749215F3D3EAB9.target: 七年的谷子，从没脱过粒。闻起来像一个谁也没过上的夏天。

16514465F679A4C83DD9A19C9DDE2C2D.source: Somebody tuned these chimes. Bronze does what it was cast to do.
16514465F679A4C83DD9A19C9DDE2C2D.target: 有人给这些钟铃调过音。青铜铸来做什么，就做什么。

22603117AA5C0F15647A4243E824A5B7.source: The south bell! Is the sea real? Is it bigger than the lake?
22603117AA5C0F15647A4243E824A5B7.target: 南边的钟！大海是真的吗？比湖还大吗？

23941854A3C4DD17F5C50D492ABC75D1.source: A seashell from Saltcombe, from the sea.
23941854A3C4DD17F5C50D492ABC75D1.target: 从盐谷镇带一枚贝壳，海里来的。

27982778F2FEC5F58540700F08321189.source: I keep looking at the sea and waiting for it to stop again. Silly. It's only water.
27982778F2FEC5F58540700F08321189.target: 我老是盯着海，等着它又停下来。傻吧。不过是水而已。

32018271A8F5AC0865D05E3D9A1BB023.2.source: A tale of the year that stopped

45770347C5F136C279CEFD49663E43F3.source: The chapel is cold. Seven rows of candles, all of them lit.
45770347C5F136C279CEFD49663E43F3.target: 礼拜堂里很冷。七排蜡烛，全都点着。

61924768EAFE34937C1A7F273B5637B8.source: Itemise it. He likes a thing done properly.
61924768EAFE34937C1A7F273B5637B8.target: 逐项列明。他喜欢把事情做得规规矩矩。

66461843AFE2664B2C921FD3BFC01A5A.source: Grandda said the Bell of Waking was tuned to open them. Let's see if he was right.
66461843AFE2664B2C921FD3BFC01A5A.target: 外公说过，苏醒之钟调成那个音，就是为了让它们开。看看他说得对不对。

74160077D540C32C80F7463EA219995A.source: The stream's talking under the ice by the wheel. First time since that night. I put my ear to it.
74160077D540C32C80F7463EA219995A.target: 磨坊边的冰底下，小溪在说话呢。自那晚起，这还是头一回。我把耳朵贴上去听了。

350018980D955E0E1A1A5092E01786EF.source: The drift's gone off the cellar hatch. Cider wife won't miss a bottle. Or a chest.
350018980D955E0E1A1A5092E01786EF.target: 酒窖口那堆雪没了。少一瓶酒，苹果酒娘不会发现的。少一只箱子也不会。

809169588BB3D3371E0DE3034F34D3D5.source: I came up to see the spring for myself. Wenna says I owe her for the cart.
809169588BB3D3371E0DE3034F34D3D5.target: 我上来亲眼看看春天。温娜说我还欠她一笔车钱呢。

893752004B8B34A915A9DC57882D9500.source: The lake's full of fish that think it's still the night it froze. I'll not tell them if you won't.
893752004B8B34A915A9DC57882D9500.target: 湖里满是鱼，还当现在是结冰的那天晚上呢。你不说，我也不跟它们讲。

9235568619BECB49EDB7A7D70A9B250F.source: Bound in ice for seven winters

80893500187C4AE13EE9DE1E015EF6A6.source: That's three. A blossom, a shell and a leaf. Gran says there's one more season, and it's ours.
80893500187C4AE13EE9DE1E015EF6A6.target: 三样啦。一枝花、一枚贝壳、一片叶子。阿婆说，还剩一个季节，是我们的。

981331532385267FCFF012F36F9E741A.source: ♪ Gold, little field, for the reapers are home…
981331532385267FCFF012F36F9E741A.target: ♪ 金黄吧，小麦田，割麦人回家……

A2E780479F13F4047FDA9A3AA4846B73.source: The mills? Strike the hub. Old Mabry swears by it, and he's been wrong about everything else.
A2E780479F13F4047FDA9A3AA4846B73.target: 风车？敲它的轴心。老马布里拿这招打包票，别的事他可是样样都说错了。

A5E7DCA4A3EBA090DC9C731BC1276937.source: Amberfield. Monks and mills. I've never stolen from a monk. Never had the chance.
A5E7DCA4A3EBA090DC9C731BC1276937.target: 琥珀原。修士和风车。我还从没偷过修士的东西呢。一直没逮着机会嘛。

A6CD5251D2F661EBDA47FD458C780444.source: Two bells! I've started icing them. That's how hopeful I am. Number 2,570, with a cherry on.
A6CD5251D2F661EBDA47FD458C780444.target: 两口钟啦！我都开始给蛋糕抹糖霜了。你瞧我多有盼头。第2570个，顶上还有颗樱桃呢。

A9AD547D9D339510D93AAFFC877A0AEE.source: The armour kneels where it fell, empty. There is frost on the inside of the helm, and nothing else.
A9AD547D9D339510D93AAFFC877A0AEE.target: 盔甲跪在它倒下的地方，里面空空的。头盔内侧结着一层霜，此外什么也没有。

A9D958C695E55ABA805D2B36293954D8.source: Your grandfather tuned the wayside chimes, you know. Wake, Turn, Gold. He said a wood should learn the song before the children did.
A9D958C695E55ABA805D2B36293954D8.target: 道旁那几座钟铃，是你外公调的音，你知道吧。醒、转、金。他说，林子该比孩子们先学会这首歌。

A35B690E123986136AC7631FB5B917D0.source: Go and see them all. Then come and find me with your mother.
A35B690E123986136AC7631FB5B917D0.target: 去看看大家吧。看完了，就到你妈妈那儿来找我。

A66E6B8AA98E46539EC217B4E302E7D4.source: A maple leaf from Amberfield, red as a forge. Dilly has never seen one fall.
A66E6B8AA98E46539EC217B4E302E7D4.target: 一片琥珀原的枫叶，红得像炉火。迪莉还从没见过叶子落下来。

A95F8AB9D69D11385A29AE6EC3F6C1AC.source: The year turns in order. Waking, Tides, Harvest, Rest — four bells, one at each edge of the valley, and each one frees its own edge into the season it was holding.
A95F8AB9D69D11385A29AE6EC3F6C1AC.target: 一年按次序流转。苏醒、潮汐、丰收、安眠——四口钟，山谷四边各一口。每一口都扣着一个季节，敲响了，那一边就解冻，回到那个季节里。

A300BD460FD79E1DDC003EA758B9DFBC.source: Three notes true. The last is the one I could never hold.
A300BD460FD79E1DDC003EA758B9DFBC.target: 三个音准了。最后那个，我一直没能留住。

A515B41BA4A729AF6C2EEA33804899D4.source: Never been up this far. The deer won't come past the steps.
A515B41BA4A729AF6C2EEA33804899D4.target: 我还从没上到过这么高。连鹿都不肯走过那段石阶。

A9250F38913DF9946C7FCD4430DBA047.source: Last chance for anyone to confess they've been lying this whole time…
A9250F38913DF9946C7FCD4430DBA047.target: 最后的机会啦，有谁想坦白自己一直在撒谎的……

A5383901E0EDA69A4DE530AB6F0DF339.source: ♪ Rest, little year — and begin it once more.
A5383901E0EDA69A4DE530AB6F0DF339.target: ♪ 安睡吧，小年年——再重来一遍。

A36113719C4A35B52E5459A5F64546BC.source: The gorge road. Seven winters of drift.
A36113719C4A35B52E5459A5F64546BC.target: 峡谷路。积了七个冬天的雪堆。

AA8FE585E5A1A1A6CB2AF960C4C831C4.source: All that lamp oil. The harbour master down at Saltcombe counts hers, I hear. Every lamp.
AA8FE585E5A1A1A6CB2AF960C4C831C4.target: 烧掉那么多灯油。听说盐谷镇的港务长，自家的灯油都记着数。每一盏灯都记。

AA9F16CB048532F5377C0F72CE368408.source: Is it true there was a colour called green? Not pine green. Grass green.
AA9F16CB048532F5377C0F72CE368408.target: 以前真的有一种颜色叫绿色吗？不是松树那种绿。是草的那种绿。

AC0A3F898B7EE9F3C0883025CCFED5BD.source: Seven winters of a wrong note, then. And a whole valley made to hold it.
AC0A3F898B7EE9F3C0883025CCFED5BD.target: 这么说，七个冬天，拖的竟是一个错音。还让整座山谷替我撑着它。

AD875033023A8E2C00EC0083316BE36D.source: One kraken, removed. Paid: no. …Give it here.
AD875033023A8E2C00EC0083316BE36D.target: 海怪一头，已清除。已付：否。……拿来吧。

AF3C47DF8ED4F6DAB63D1003B1E920C6.source: Oh, that's lovely. I'm never leaving this spot.
AF3C47DF8ED4F6DAB63D1003B1E920C6.target: 哎呀，这可真舒服。我再也不挪窝了。

AF59E643A09EBE93A87374FC4CF35BE2.source: Every knight carried a piece of my winter. That one carried the piece that was sorry.
AF59E643A09EBE93A87374FC4CF35BE2.target: 每一具骑士都扛着我这场冬天的一块。那一具扛着的，是心怀愧疚的那一块。

AFA066954FB0D36FB92A71DB09C9A5CD.source: A rota on the door: the night watch, every night, for seven years. Nobody has crossed a name off.
AFA066954FB0D36FB92A71DB09C9A5CD.target: 门上贴着值班表：夜哨，每晚一班，排了七年。没有一个名字被划掉。

B0BE1480C30F38910ED2E903F8874225.source: It's a knight. It's with us. It doesn't do crows.
B0BE1480C30F38910ED2E903F8874225.target: 它是骑士。跟我们一起的。赶乌鸦可不归它管。

B0F2DAA3FC939EDBDD9CAAF35AB38631.source: The Frost Gate. Ice to the sky — and it hums, when the wind's in the north.
B0F2DAA3FC939EDBDD9CAAF35AB38631.target: 霜之门。冰一直垒到天上——北风一吹，它还会嗡嗡作响。

B1AC7C9F63DC86D1D71A80B65FE164C8.source: The nets are frozen into one grey block. Somebody has chalked FEE PAID on it.
B1AC7C9F63DC86D1D71A80B65FE164C8.target: 渔网冻成了灰扑扑的一整块。有人用粉笔在上面写着：费用已付。

B6B647CAB383E61BC67D2C7FB998B7DC.source: Two bells, Mam. There's a harbour master who fights with a door. You'd have liked her.
B6B647CAB383E61BC67D2C7FB998B7DC.target: 两口钟了，妈。有个港务长，抡着一扇门打架。你肯定会喜欢她。

B6CF6999294FB8A61FD60DDA96D2AC22.source: Two thousand five hundred and fifty-seven lamps, one a night, for a brother's boat. Wenna has joined us — and taken her office door.
B6CF6999294FB8A61FD60DDA96D2AC22.target: 两千五百五十七盏灯，一夜一盏，为了弟弟的船。温娜加入了我们——还把港务所的门拆下来带上了。

B16E332170ED6A8300B6DBE5EA913CBA.source: Corin Ashby knows the wood. The chimes come first, he says — the shrine gate has not opened since the frost.
B16E332170ED6A8300B6DBE5EA913CBA.target: 科林·阿什比熟悉这片林子。他说要先敲钟铃——自从霜冻降临，神祠的大门就再没开过。

B45E50C4C2DF502F4823E1AA6B258963.source: I've been as far south as Saltcombe twice. Once on purpose.
B45E50C4C2DF502F4823E1AA6B258963.target: 我往南最远到过盐谷镇，去过两回。有一回还是故意去的呢。

B46BDB964B7EBA772004680E5613CD75.source: Under that, very large, the chalk snapped halfway: EAST TOO!!!
B46BDB964B7EBA772004680E5613CD75.target: 再下面，字写得很大，粉笔写到一半断了：东边也响啦！！！

B53BCCC22D84A636F2176772E707AEC5.source: Tell it it's welcome to the field any year it likes.
B53BCCC22D84A636F2176772E707AEC5.target: 跟它说，哪年想来田里都行，我们都欢迎。

B62D023B2ECB2ACE9AFF770EB0B8825D.source: The Knight at the Forge Door

B63DD723BF57243D39782CDAD8D8B2A6.source: We sat down to eat, and the light never moved.
B63DD723BF57243D39782CDAD8D8B2A6.target: 我们坐下吃饭，天光就再没动过。

B78B2DC684DFCA249608AA5407CD0DE7.source: Will you bring me a flower? A real one?
B78B2DC684DFCA249608AA5407CD0DE7.target: 你能给我带一朵花回来吗？真的花？

B87F147A588C90093704A1C2D0DFADCB.source: But there are cantors in the fields now — hollow things in choir robes, ringing bells of their own. When a cantor rings, the knights mend.
B87F147A588C90093704A1C2D0DFADCB.target: 可如今田里有了咏者——穿着唱诗袍的空壳子，摇着它们自己的铃。咏者的铃一响，骑士就修好了。

B199C28A378FDC953A0DDE206F45E4AC.source: Warm through the door: cinnamon, and something burning slightly.
B199C28A378FDC953A0DDE206F45E4AC.target: 暖意从门里透出来：肉桂的香味，还夹着一丝焦糊味。

B215E4DA49F9F4BC0FA7768DB9400FFF.source: The west road to the Blossomwood is open.
B215E4DA49F9F4BC0FA7768DB9400FFF.target: 通往繁花林的西路开通了。

B224E32F31E88C7B9B8CB4CE8D915E60.target: 去吧，守钟人。去把它们唤醒。

B547B7BAD7FAF6D97E378BA3646C4CB5.source: Chalked under it, in a child's round hand: THE WEST BELL RANG.
B547B7BAD7FAF6D97E378BA3646C4CB5.target: 下面用粉笔写着，是孩子圆圆的字迹：西边的钟响了。

B730A2AE01E985FFF1857DD8BD57D627.source: Seven years in Evermere sleeping on my sister's floor. You've no idea what she snores like.
B730A2AE01E985FFF1857DD8BD57D627.target: 在永湖镇我姐家的地板上睡了七年。你都想不到她打呼噜是什么动静。

B2074D4B3CA3577442F3A7C748761760.source: There. Gone back down where it came from. And you'll want a receipt for that.
B2074D4B3CA3577442F3A7C748761760.target: 好了。打哪儿来的回哪儿去了。这一笔，得给你们开张收据。

B8360F956A4D40E37B2D211F71CA9865.source: Sit a moment. You've brought the spring up a hill; you can rest your legs.
B8360F956A4D40E37B2D211F71CA9865.target: 坐一会儿吧。你把春天带上了山，也该歇歇腿了。

B52988BD981613DBDEDBC260AD425B98.source: Mam's shawl. Some nights I can hear the song she sang me, right up to the last line. Then nothing.
B52988BD981613DBDEDBC260AD425B98.target: 妈妈的披肩。有些夜里，我能听见她唱给我的那首歌，一直到最后一句。然后，就什么都没了。

B18768369826AF629B3C0BDB85CE95B9.source: The Knight at the Forge Door

BABF7D43C2ABD5CA5C40DB7AE9ED93DA.source: A tale of the year that stopped

BADFAAC259ADCB428DC70B74616F86FF.source: One kraken, removed. Paid: no. The lighthouse is up the cliff stair.
BADFAAC259ADCB428DC70B74616F86FF.target: 海怪一头，已清除。已付：否。灯塔在悬崖石阶的上头。

BC808E4453575F099BE08F1204038C0E.source: A shield, if you like. I'll want that back.
BC808E4453575F099BE08F1204038C0E.target: 就当是面盾牌吧。这可是港务所的门，回头得还。

BCC34966A6604F5F0E1719464C4D6229.source: The Frost Gate. Seven winters thick.
BCC34966A6604F5F0E1719464C4D6229.target: 霜之门。冻了七个冬天的厚冰。

BCD89318AC14CEC01D4367BF1A069601.source: Three chimes rung, and the hill's still shut. Maybe it wants a fourth. Maybe it wants a fee.
BCD89318AC14CEC01D4367BF1A069601.target: 三座钟铃都敲过了，山上还是关着。也许它想要第四座。也许它想收点费。

BCF0A6F1BF293FB10175D431EA247295.source: The citadel at the head of the valley

BD81AA8799F6D6B835644ACE5E766438.source: Abbey bell's up the hill, past the mills. They've not turned since. Nor has anything.
BD81AA8799F6D6B835644ACE5E766438.target: 修道院的钟在山上，过了那几座风车就到。打那以后，风车一直没转过。什么都没再动过。

BDCB9E047375BA1BCBA72655E3FF703A.source: Listen. Hear that creak? She's turning. She's turning!
BDCB9E047375BA1BCBA72655E3FF703A.target: 听。听见那嘎吱声没？它在转。它转起来了！

BE4C35F88F1D6CAAB12049824E78CEA6.source: Don't let it be morning, Grandda. Please.
BE4C35F88F1D6CAAB12049824E78CEA6.target: 外公，别让天亮。求求你了。

BE363A294AB868D7CBE98D4F75704A92.source: Linnet! LINNET! Look at my crown!
BE363A294AB868D7CBE98D4F75704A92.target: 琳内特！琳内特——！快看我的花冠！

BEAC09F49B5A38FAF8CD511FF5C65FFA.source: One ridge, removed. I'll put it on the account.
BEAC09F49B5A38FAF8CD511FF5C65FFA.target: 冰脊一道，已清除。记在账上。

BF3F630A881569C982792909A5A3E15D.source: That's a mooring fee, that is. And that one. And you, with the face.
BF3F630A881569C982792909A5A3E15D.target: 这只得交停泊费，跑不了。那只也是。还有你，摆着张臭脸的那只。

BF019AE9C109FC59C17C58021946CD0C.source: The stream heard it. Well. There's my bridge.
BF019AE9C109FC59C17C58021946CD0C.target: 溪水听见了。好吧。我的桥来了。

BF862A40610621DE09F2998FC3135346.source: ♪ Turn, little tide, bring the boats back to shore…
BF862A40610621DE09F2998FC3135346.target: ♪ 转回吧，小潮水，送船儿归岸……

C0C63D0FBE6F6F1EC5EC20CC4D4973B9.source: Three chimes rung, and the hill's still shut. Maybe it wants a fourth. Maybe it wants a fee.
C0C63D0FBE6F6F1EC5EC20CC4D4973B9.target: 三座钟铃都敲过了，山上还是关着。也许它想要第四座。也许它想收点费。

C2B45788C7CC702B17E993273B07AAE8.source: Take a slice for the road. …No? Nobody ever does. The crows won't touch them any more either.
C2B45788C7CC702B17E993273B07AAE8.target: 拿一块路上吃吧。……不要？谁都不要。现在连乌鸦都不碰了。

C4A51D895A57E22C298716C09CDE9C84.source: Gone nowhere? We came round the head in a fog so thick you could lean on it. Last thing I saw before it closed — old Halloway, up on the north road, ringing a bell black as a kettle.
C4A51D895A57E22C298716C09CDE9C84.target: 哪儿都没去？我们绕过岬角的时候，雾浓得都能靠上去。雾合拢前我看见的最后一样东西——是老哈洛韦，在北边的路上，敲着一口黑得像锅底的钟。

C04D4E2B0B8BDD6B38DE80F489DA9A40.source: I told you. I told everyone.
C04D4E2B0B8BDD6B38DE80F489DA9A40.target: 我早说过吧。我跟所有人都说过。

C24B250B6F2CB96ABB31816F1C4568A4.source: Nobody moors in the basin. Not since my father's day. The fishermen say there's something under it.
C24B250B6F2CB96ABB31816F1C4568A4.target: 没人在港池停船。打我爹那时候起就没有了。渔夫们说，底下有东西。

C41BAE39479C4C203E8FB58172E98B05.source: Bigger than the lake. It doesn't stop. It just goes on till it's sky.
C41BAE39479C4C203E8FB58172E98B05.target: 比湖大。它没有尽头。一直往前，直到变成天。

C43DB7419EA3FAD33C695C56A5AE9BE6.source: The Knight at the Forge Door

C69DC76944273D4BCA15572C4BCDA9F1.source: Now bring me a leaf. A red one. Gran says they go red before they fall, like they're embarrassed.
C69DC76944273D4BCA15572C4BCDA9F1.target: 那下回给我带一片叶子吧。红的。阿婆说，叶子掉下来之前会变红，就像害羞了一样。

C82BC35FF4CF17162EA69BE759787420.source: The year has turned, and spring has come to Evermere. Grandda has gone to sit with Mam in the churchyard.
C82BC35FF4CF17162EA69BE759787420.target: 这一年又流转起来了，春天来到了永湖镇。外公去教堂墓园陪妈妈坐坐了。

C94D8E6407589853F2052A5E0113DE56.source: I should go and sit with your mother. Seven years, and I never once went.
C94D8E6407589853F2052A5E0113DE56.target: 我该去你妈妈那儿坐坐了。七年了，我一次也没去过。

C94DB1844E241C2B1E57AF7F34C124B8.source: First pressing in seven years. It's a bit sharp. So am I.
C94DB1844E241C2B1E57AF7F34C124B8.target: 七年来头一回榨的酒。有点冲。跟我一样。

C573BB3E8EB4BFE7CA73F85FC246CF33.source: Her sails haven't turned since that night. I grease her every week anyway. You never know.
C573BB3E8EB4BFE7CA73F85FC246CF33.target: 自那晚起，风车就没转过。我还是每周给它上油。说不准哪天呢。

C2180CC8B7356A3185F1C6A343D1D9A4.source: Something walks in the Harvest Close at dusk. Which is always, now. It wears a coat.
C2180CC8B7356A3185F1C6A343D1D9A4.target: 每到黄昏，丰收围场里就有个东西走来走去。如今可一直都是黄昏。它穿着件大衣。

C5900A5C01904326D4422451BA9FEBEA.source: And the Hushguard came out of the snow behind him. Dozens. Following the note like hounds after a horn. North, the lot of them.
C5900A5C01904326D4422451BA9FEBEA.target: 寂静卫士就跟在他身后，从雪里走了出来。几十具。追着那个音走，就像猎犬追着号角。全都往北去了。

C6154AC2C81DC921458ED3F97ACE307D.source: West first. The Bell of Waking.

CACE10EE2E10FC321EA162ED128878DE.source: A tale of the year that stopped

CB5B2B9AC74F95DF33C9C54590868975.source: Here. It's yours. It always was going to be.
CB5B2B9AC74F95DF33C9C54590868975.target: 拿着吧。它是你的了。早晚都会是你的。

CB275E1E80F35C8A12A67898064AB304.source: Listen to that. Running water. I'd forgotten it had a voice.
CB275E1E80F35C8A12A67898064AB304.target: 听听。流水声。我都忘了它还有自己的嗓音呢。

CBA8AAFAE8F84F7DFA701E3AC658B088.source: Every bell in the valley just rang at once, and you look like somebody stood on your foot.
CBA8AAFAE8F84F7DFA701E3AC658B088.target: 全山谷的钟刚刚一齐响了，你倒好，一脸像是被人踩了脚还硬撑着。

CBD99F3126D6E1EAE9DDDECDF258F844.source: Every fire's out — stand in your own bell's ring, Linnet!
CBD99F3126D6E1EAE9DDDECDF258F844.target: 火全灭了——快躲进你自己那口钟的钟声里，琳内特！

CC7A7DF3429A0959D9CC1F7AB49FC317.source: Gull Steps, clear again. My father carried his lamps up these every evening for forty years.
CC7A7DF3429A0959D9CC1F7AB49FC317.target: 海鸥石阶，又通了。我爹四十年来每天傍晚都提着灯，从这儿爬上去。

CD709F5A1B5B3DAEEA60B015A41BEEA5.source: One bell. It's blossom out west, Mam. Pink and white. You'd have picked an armful.
CD709F5A1B5B3DAEEA60B015A41BEEA5.target: 一口钟了。西边开花了，妈。粉的，白的。你要是在，准会摘上一大抱。

CDF64CE00F013692428A8B42DB6B57D7.source: Wake, little blossom… turn, little tide… gold, little field. Wake, turn, gold.
CDF64CE00F013692428A8B42DB6B57D7.target: 醒来吧，小花苞……转回吧，小潮水……金黄吧，小麦田。醒、转、金。

CDF301EFAD5DBE32E6A364B6FE0F3B07.source: Ice shove. The whole lake's been leaning on this shore since the freeze. I'd need a crowbar the size of a mast.
CDF301EFAD5DBE32E6A364B6FE0F3B07.target: 冰推。自从湖面封冻，整个湖就一直压在这片岸上。得有根桅杆那么粗的撬棍才撬得动。

CE2F936AC804510CBC4CFE43C14549BE.source: Seven years? It was Tuesday a minute ago. Is old Penhallow still at the chandlery? He owes me a rope.
CE2F936AC804510CBC4CFE43C14549BE.target: 七年？刚才还是星期二呢。老彭哈洛还在船具店吗？他还欠我一根绳子。

CF2770A5D6429679A2E2041A08A6DD4F.source: Grandda is waiting at the square's bell.
CF2770A5D6429679A2E2041A08A6DD4F.target: 外公在广场的钟那儿等我。

CFB32D4804DE00323E42DF50CC76D4D4.source: First morning I've not had to light a lamp. I don't know what to do with my hands.
CFB32D4804DE00323E42DF50CC76D4D4.target: 头一个不用点灯的早晨。我都不知道这双手该往哪儿放了。

D0D35BECE39151DB5AAA8E0B7FCEC0D8.source: So. Ringers first. Then the knights. Then supper.
D0D35BECE39151DB5AAA8E0B7FCEC0D8.target: 所以说，先对付鸣钟者。再对付骑士。然后吃晚饭。

D2F2C5C6DA5420D07CB357A758D2D0EC.target: 早安，妈。……不，是傍晚。永远是傍晚。

D3A1AC1923D32E31C187569D15886AEF.source: Hymn sheets frozen to the lectern. Every hymn on them is the same four notes, backwards.
D3A1AC1923D32E31C187569D15886AEF.target: 赞美诗页冻在诵经台上。上面每一首都是同样的四个音，倒着唱。

D8E2694E8837AA82A1281352194E4B9C.source: When that bell goes, stand by a fire. I'm not paying to dig anyone out.
D8E2694E8837AA82A1281352194E4B9C.target: 那口钟一响，就站到火边去。我可不出钱把谁刨出来。

D9EE575DF5D3DFF1288A5ED48C22C053.target: 没有？那就只有我一个了。

D51D3552B3C0F62E81F69F0FE6CA2D5A.source: Draughts too, if you're hurt. Wenna makes me keep them. Says it's a harbour regulation. It isn't.
D51D3552B3C0F62E81F69F0FE6CA2D5A.target: 您要是受了伤，我这儿也有治疗药水。温娜非让我备着，说是港口的规定。才不是呢。

D83C7F1FCE4E049A94B295B1354931F5.source: When I was a girl the sun went backwards for a whole afternoon. Nobody else noticed. Typical.
D83C7F1FCE4E049A94B295B1354931F5.target: 我还是个小丫头的时候，太阳倒着走了一整个下午。别人谁也没发现。哼，向来如此。

D404E3B636D6A135372C009549CF1FC8.source: Look! A crown of everything! A blossom, a shell, a red leaf — and a snowdrop, so winter doesn't feel left out.
D404E3B636D6A135372C009549CF1FC8.target: 你看！一顶什么都有的花冠！一枝花、一枚贝壳、一片红叶——还有一朵雪花莲，这样冬天就不会觉得被落下啦。

D724AB7DB72A9DB188242386269828EE.target: 逮住你了，你这偷东西的——

D8281F683C5E2A76E35A4233104168D5.source: Seven years I watched that wall, and I'd have sworn nothing could shift it. Mind how you go up there.
D8281F683C5E2A76E35A4233104168D5.target: 那道墙我守了七年，本来敢发誓，什么都挪不动它。上去以后当心点。

D85354E12B619DA8AF38F9AC6347E316.source: ↓ The gorge road to Saltcombe. The Bell of Tides.
D85354E12B619DA8AF38F9AC6347E316.target: ↓ 峡谷路，通往盐谷镇。潮汐之钟。

D838037F0C3A5672E04F0CCE85461DD3.source: The west bell, was it? Then I'll have flour on my hands by summer. Mark me.
D838037F0C3A5672E04F0CCE85461DD3.target: 是西边的钟，对吧？那到了夏天，我手上就该沾满面粉了。你记着。

DAF04985981766DDD055A12B007999DF.source: Seven years she asked me what green smelled like. I said wait. I'm glad I said wait.
DAF04985981766DDD055A12B007999DF.target: 七年来她老问我，绿色是什么味道。我说，等着吧。幸好我说的是等着。

DAFBF9B2DD4A76C1FB2AD2D62E4183ED.source: It's RED. Is it hot? It looks hot. …It's not hot.
DAFBF9B2DD4A76C1FB2AD2D62E4183ED.target: 是红的！红的哦！烫不烫？看着好烫。……不烫。

DD74520AB8B1FC3DF3FBC738E2302271.source: My hands shake now. A Bellkeeper wants steady hands.
DD74520AB8B1FC3DF3FBC738E2302271.target: 我的手如今会抖了。守钟人得有一双稳当的手。

DED0335C0D54F7B6C2175A490FEDDF84.source: The sails are turning. That's all this one has to give.
DED0335C0D54F7B6C2175A490FEDDF84.target: 风车转起来了。这一座能给的就这些。

DFA5B1CC79AEFD66267D5911FD5FE263.source: The bells are broken, girl. Everyone knows that.
DFA5B1CC79AEFD66267D5911FD5FE263.target: 钟都坏啦，丫头。谁不知道。

DFD121A62F2D508DAA15AEFAADC11730.source: The three chimes ring the first notes of Mam's song. Strike them in its order: Wake, Turn, Gold.
DFD121A62F2D508DAA15AEFAADC11730.target: 三座钟铃敲出的，是妈妈那首歌开头的几个音。按歌里的顺序敲响它们：醒、转、金。

E1DD52EE89296FD0473F1A61205DAADE.source: They're all red over there. Red and gold, the whole field. Like the forge, but quiet.
E1DD52EE89296FD0473F1A61205DAADE.target: 那边全是红的。红的、金的，整片田野都是。像铸钟坊，只是静悄悄的。

E1FAC7E383054A75AB00207F90175C66.source: I've come to ring the Bell of Tides.
E1FAC7E383054A75AB00207F90175C66.target: 我是来敲响潮汐之钟的。

E3B5E40D6C00F1D035D0DF371E4426C4.source: The reeve's door stands open, as it has for seven years. The supper is outside, where the light was.
E3B5E40D6C00F1D035D0DF371E4426C4.target: 庄头家的门敞着，七年来一直如此。晚饭摆在屋外——摆在当时还有光的地方。

E4D5ECE328FD596C7C9216DC359997C0.source: Can I keep it forever? Will it stay?
E4D5ECE328FD596C7C9216DC359997C0.target: 我能永远留着它吗？它会一直在吗？

E5F24F5335E9233AD1E4EE373D963EFB.source: Mam's gone, Grandda. She was gone before morning.
E5F24F5335E9233AD1E4EE373D963EFB.target: 妈已经走了，外公。天没亮她就走了。

E9A8E8834A2C8AD8C396D43B4CA6DDC5.source: I'm keeping a tally. You'll want to be on the right side of it.
E9A8E8834A2C8AD8C396D43B4CA6DDC5.target: 我一笔笔都记着账呢。你最好别落到欠账那一栏里。

E22A14C192445854C990E3E4F7DE63F0.source: No mooring past the second bollard. — W. Gale
E22A14C192445854C990E3E4F7DE63F0.target: 第二根系缆桩以外禁止停泊。——W. 盖尔

E24A0C67E11B8A78DBF5BE8D84483A6D.source: It wants them in order. Those three notes — they're the start of Mam's song.
E24A0C67E11B8A78DBF5BE8D84483A6D.target: 它要按顺序来。那三个音——是妈妈那首歌的开头。

E40FB6AE2E22C8C5F6F7C3665A0E965A.source: Tin's armour stands beside the grave, empty. Blossom drifts down into its open helm.
E40FB6AE2E22C8C5F6F7C3665A0E965A.target: 阿锡的盔甲立在墓旁，里面空空的。花瓣飘落，落进它敞开的头盔里。

E41FF83703E8F311BF0F60BC990DB8FF.source: Oh, look, Cob — they've brought us a new mawkin. Isn't it handsome?
E41FF83703E8F311BF0F60BC990DB8FF.target: 哎呀，你瞧，柯伯——他们给咱们带来个新稻草人。多俊哪！

E64B939984B18583F629BC387A01B1EA.source: Four bells in a row and a fifth, coloured in black. Underneath, in a child's letters: SO MAM CAN STAY.
E64B939984B18583F629BC387A01B1EA.target: 一排四口钟，还有第五口，涂成了黑色。下面是孩子写的字：让妈妈留下来。

E98ECCF8CC3D6FA70FB7C2F849A7008A.source: Osmund Halloway's old work coat, taken off the Harvest Mawkin. Bell-metal burns on both cuffs.
E98ECCF8CC3D6FA70FB7C2F849A7008A.target: 奥斯蒙德·哈洛韦的旧工作大衣，从丰收稻草人身上取下来的。两只袖口上都有钟铜烫出的焦痕。

E341E44CD2E349322EEF6863C2459B7A.source: Visitors. First since the ice. Morwenna Gale, harbour master — that'll be a landing fee.
E341E44CD2E349322EEF6863C2459B7A.target: 来客了。结冰以来头一批。莫温娜·盖尔，港务长——这得收登岸费。

E681A93C063F7C1CF959F2A19C901BFB.source: The charcoal burner's hut. His last fire is still laid in the hearth, seven years unlit.
E681A93C063F7C1CF959F2A19C901BFB.target: 烧炭人的小屋。他最后一炉火的柴还码在炉膛里，七年没点过。

E958F3371E9FBB0A490214C5F5FECD01.source: A flower from the Blossomwood. A real one.
E958F3371E9FBB0A490214C5F5FECD01.target: 从繁花林带一朵花。要真的。

E1533CF9F0C8667CB6AEC6D60788565C.source: The chapter house. Seven years of hymn sheets, frozen to the lectern in the middle of a verse.
E1533CF9F0C8667CB6AEC6D60788565C.target: 修士会堂。诵经台上的赞美诗页冻了七年，正停在一节唱到一半的地方。

E7134DE65A4DC2BE6BB76D82B6C2A82C.source: A knight walked right past the forge last night. I hid. Bravely.
E7134DE65A4DC2BE6BB76D82B6C2A82C.target: 昨晚有个骑士从铸钟坊门前走过去了。我躲起来了。躲得可勇敢了。

E9382E034A2573A229EBE3449E3C9A9B.source: Like the forge but quiet. …I'm going to think about that all night.
E9382E034A2573A229EBE3449E3C9A9B.target: 像铸钟坊，只是静悄悄的。……我要想它一整晚。

E74454985700C6CE7FFFE8E8708F76E0.target: 音还是准的。好歹还有这个。

EAF1BD5552BB72CFD50B98F1766D4666.source: Somebody tuned these chimes. Bronze does what it was cast to do.
EAF1BD5552BB72CFD50B98F1766D4666.target: 有人给这些钟铃调过音。青铜铸来做什么，就做什么。

EBD9CDE2ED88AE432127AF31F2910307.source: I asked after Mabli Price all morning. Married a cooper. Three children. Seven years, and I still had a ribbon for her in my pocket.
EBD9CDE2ED88AE432127AF31F2910307.target: 我打听了一上午玛布丽·普赖斯的消息。嫁了个箍桶匠。三个孩子了。七年了，我兜里还揣着给她的一根缎带呢。

ECB1EAC05E1951F03E414BCDA8DC1CE5.source: Twelve places, eleven empty. And a pie nobody's cut. That's a supper owed.
ECB1EAC05E1951F03E414BCDA8DC1CE5.target: 十二个座位，空了十一个。还有个没人切过的馅饼。这顿晚饭算是欠下了。

ECF73D07A42FEB4A899FB272063FC88C.source: Empty. A kettle on a cold hob, and the gulls nesting in the chimney.
ECF73D07A42FEB4A899FB272063FC88C.target: 屋里空着。冰冷的灶台上搁着一只水壶，海鸥在烟囱里筑了巢。

EDD6FD65FF7C7F0B608EC9857814373F.source: Then we'll go up and have a word with him. I've brought the ledger.
EDD6FD65FF7C7F0B608EC9857814373F.target: 那咱们就上去，跟他好好说道说道。账本我带着呢。

EFA64D82760CE69E89E0D382383017CE.source: Petals in my hair. Seven years of snow and now petals. I'll never get them out.
EFA64D82760CE69E89E0D382383017CE.target: 花瓣都落进我头发里了。下了七年的雪，现在倒下起花瓣来了。这下可再也弄不干净啦。

F0D43513A63A76CA7EBFFDF6D48D5501.source: It stood at our door every night. Seven years.
F0D43513A63A76CA7EBFFDF6D48D5501.target: 它每晚都站在我们家门口。七年。

F1B0D320FDAB17D323E48D3C0F0E78B8.source: Look at it. Gold to the hedges. I'd forgotten wheat could move.
F1B0D320FDAB17D323E48D3C0F0E78B8.target: 瞧瞧。金灿灿的，一直铺到树篱边。我都忘了麦子是会动的。

F1D94AF5443D52A52239E4BB504F88FC.source: Whatever he is up there, he's your family. I'll bill him gently.
F1D94AF5443D52A52239E4BB504F88FC.target: 不管他在上面成了什么，他总归是你的家人。账单我会开得客气些。

F002B37EE197632642B6550D70B858A4.source: They say the fish at Saltcombe come the size of carts. I'll believe it once I've told it myself.
F002B37EE197632642B6550D70B858A4.target: 听说盐谷镇的鱼有大车那么大。等我自己讲过一遍，我就信啦。

F6BD78DBF013D57C10CF593116882BB7.source: And then the abbey bell, clear across the valley, and we all just — got up and walked home.
F6BD78DBF013D57C10CF593116882BB7.target: 后来修道院的钟声传遍了山谷，我们就都——站起身，走回家了。

F6EA5DE509F7F52D6AF9DBCBD60ED1AD.source: Wake, turn, gold. The gate heard it. Up the hill, then.
F6EA5DE509F7F52D6AF9DBCBD60ED1AD.target: 醒、转、金。大门听见了。那就上山吧。

F7FFD77E037C4ED2CDAB865C79D9C9B2.source: Mam's shawl. I remember the last line now. I'll sing it to her when it's morning.
F7FFD77E037C4ED2CDAB865C79D9C9B2.target: 妈妈的披肩。最后一句我想起来了。等天亮了，我唱给她听。

F8CCE1D4465146A3E0F3C0605F1BCD2A.source: A spiral shell the first tide in seven years brought to Saltcombe's quay. Dilly has never heard the sea in one.
F8CCE1D4465146A3E0F3C0605F1BCD2A.target: 一枚螺旋形的贝壳，七年来的第一场潮水把它送上了盐谷镇的码头。迪莉还从没在贝壳里听见过大海。

F9BFB8171FC5D6CFB215F98AB284F329.2.source: Rest, little year — and begin it once more
F9BFB8171FC5D6CFB215F98AB284F329.2.target: 安睡吧，小年年——再重来一遍

F046F5EE58867A352AE2050955577CE7.source: Where the Bell of Tides hangs

F48DC95D1282E7B3B721D3FE454C1545.source: I taught your grandfather to ring. Left hand on the rope, right hand on your heart. He never listened.
F48DC95D1282E7B3B721D3FE454C1545.target: 你外公敲钟还是我教的呢。左手拉绳，右手按在心口。他从来不听。

F50C2BA1A68135E546A8ADC2C503B082.source: A handbell. Does it work on the Hushguard?
F50C2BA1A68135E546A8ADC2C503B082.target: 手摇铃。对寂静卫士管用吗？

F65F145CDC71A1F171798C77182B55DB.source: It wasn't dead. It was waiting.

F68ACB2367A80AEAB158B3D784779064.source: Brother Fallow's lesson: the cantors ring and the knights mend. Silence the ringers first. The mills' fog closes the lane to the abbey.
F68ACB2367A80AEAB158B3D784779064.target: 法洛修士教的：咏者一敲钟，骑士就会修复。先让鸣钟者噤声。风车那边的雾封住了通往修道院的小路。

F88AE9FACD647FBD931A91EDC70112DB.source: Tin looks at Linnet for a long moment. Then it reaches out and straightens her collar.
F88AE9FACD647FBD931A91EDC70112DB.target: 阿锡久久地望着琳内特。然后它伸出手，替她理了理衣领。

F41439BE9912BF2F3859B6055130D96F.source: You're telling me somebody tuned a whole wood to a lullaby.
F41439BE9912BF2F3859B6055130D96F.target: 你是说，有人照着一首摇篮曲给整片林子调了音？

FA3AE77F8AA8EB66AE9885418D30B797.source: The east road. Not before the Bell of Tides.
FA3AE77F8AA8EB66AE9885418D30B797.target: 东边的路。得等潮汐之钟响过再说。

FB3E2248685742C1CF347027B647EAC6.source: It wants them in order. Those three notes — they're the start of Mam's song.
FB3E2248685742C1CF347027B647EAC6.target: 它要按顺序来。那三个音——是妈妈那首歌的开头。

FD3A13996E4175F5C39D00831FF0FA56.source: Somebody inside is arguing with a kettle, and winning.
FD3A13996E4175F5C39D00831FF0FA56.target: 屋里有人在跟一只水壶吵架，而且吵赢了。

FD8F4E015A4CFAD000E9CC5171EC4DD0.source: Iron's iron. Hit it till it rings — then hit what's underneath.
FD8F4E015A4CFAD000E9CC5171EC4DD0.target: 铁就是铁。敲到它响——再敲里头那东西。

FE2DE483BD18969F483626DC958DE005.source: ← The Blossomwood. The Bell of Waking.

FE37BF36B57F989710F72D520AB90C9D.source: Through the door: a fiddle, badly tuned, and somebody laughing anyway.
FE37BF36B57F989710F72D520AB90C9D.target: 门里传来一把走了音的提琴声，可还是有人在笑。

FF7C628C654C9B791592CC71F852D85A.source: Then we light our own. Brazier iron holds its heat. It only wants a spark.
FF7C628C654C9B791592CC71F852D85A.target: 那我们就自己点火。火盆的铁能存住热。只差一点火星。

FF75BC0872302ED8CA938AC6B7082D8D.source: Under it, in a lamplighter's careful capitals: AND THE SOUTH ONE.
FF75BC0872302ED8CA938AC6B7082D8D.target: 下面是点灯人一笔一画的工整大字：南边的也响了。

FF6295EACFB1674D27FD32955138ED0D.source: CLOSED FOR THE SEASON. The season has lasted seven years.
FF6295EACFB1674D27FD32955138ED0D.target: 本季歇业。这一季已经持续了七年。
